weapons.name: Burnt Sienna
weapons.source: Dropped by Tomb Crawlers
weapons.why: strong early ranged melee whip option
weapons.effect: Enemies killed using the weapon will drop three small orbs that each heal the player for 2 HP when picked up.

weapons.name: Enchanted Boomerang
weapons.source: Crafted at By Hand
weapons.why: Upgraded boomerang that returns faster and hits harder.

weapons.name: Starfury
weapons.source: Found in Skyware Chests (Floating Islands)
weapons.why: Calls a falling star from the sky on each swing.

weapons.name: Terragrim
weapons.source: Rare drop from Enchanted Sword Shrine swords
weapons.why: Rapidly releases a flurry of slash projectiles toward the cursor when used.

weapons.name: Bladecrest Oathsword
weapons.source: Dropped by Demons and Voodoo Demons in The Underworld
weapons.effect: It throws a sword that sticks into enemies, with a max of 3 being able to be stuck into a single enemy. If another is stuck, the oldest one will be launched out.

weapons.name: Old Lord Claymore
weapons.source: Dropped by Bone Serpents
weapons.why: strong projectile melee sword, primary pick
weapons.effect: When used, it performs a slow, high knockback slash with a custom animation that inflicts the Hellfire debuff.

weapons.name: Blade of Grass
weapons.source: Crafted at Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
weapons.why: Fires a homing Leaf Blade projectile on each swing.

weapons.name: Depth Crusher
weapons.source: Dropped by Viperfish, or found in the Void Chest in the Abyss Shrine
weapons.effect: Tosses a heavy crusher that ricochets off tiles and enemies and releases water energy, inflicting Riptide.
weapons.why: Ricocheting abyssal crusher.

weapons.name: Malaise
weapons.source: Crafted at Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
weapons.why: Corruption counterpart of the Crimson's Artery.

weapons.name: Artery
weapons.source: Crafted at Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
weapons.why: Crimson counterpart of the Corruption's Malaise.

weapons.name: Thorn Chakram
weapons.source: Crafted at Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
weapons.why: Bouncing chakram that inflicts Poisoned.

armor.name: Platinum armor
armor.source: Crafted at Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
armor.why: No set bonus. Worth wearing if you find the ore, but not worth mining for: the first boss drops a better set.
armor.desc: Platinum armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Platinum Helmet, Platinum Chainmail, and Platinum Greaves. The full set grants 20 defense while equipped.
armor.effect: +4 defense · +10% damage reduction

accessories.name: Dunerider Boots
accessories.source: Dropped by Desert enemies, or found in Sandstone Chests in the Underground Desert
accessories.effect: The wearer can run super fast, and even faster on sand

accessories.name: Sandstorm in a Bottle
accessories.source: Found in Pyramids in the Desert, and craftable by hand.
accessories.effect: Allows the holder to do an improved double jump

accessories.name: Fledgling Wings
accessories.source: Found in Skyware Chests, Sky Crates, and Azure Crates, and craftable by hand.
accessories.why: Allows the player to fly briefly and glide (and negates fall damage).

accessories.name: Shark Tooth Necklace
accessories.source: Drops from Blood Zombies and Dripplers during a Blood Moon
accessories.why: Provides all weapons with 5 unconditional armor penetration. Can be stacked with or upgraded into the Stinger Necklace.

accessories.name: Magiluminescence
accessories.source: Crafted at an Iron or Lead Anvil
accessories.effect: +15% maximum speed, +75% acceleration, and emits light.

accessories.name: Feral Claws
accessories.source: Found in Jungle chests or Jungle Crates
accessories.why: Increases melee attack speed and grants autoswing to melee weapons.

accessories.name: Counterweight
accessories.source: Purchased from the Traveling Merchant or Skeleton Merchant
accessories.effect: Throws a counterweight at enemies after a yoyo hit.

accessories.name: Rover Drive
accessories.effect: When equipped for 10 seconds without taking damage, a protective matrix covers its user, which grants 20 matrix durability. If the player gets hit, durability is lost instead of health by the amount of damage taken.

accessories.name: Luxor's Gift
accessories.effect: Summons a scarab launcher that follows you closely · The scarab launcher fires different projectiles at enemies depending on your held weapon type

buffs.name: Lesser Healing Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at a Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: This duration can be reduced via the Philosopher's Stone or Charm of Myths. It is the first tier of healing potion, preceding the Healing Potion, Greater Healing Potion, Jungle Juice and Super Healing Potion.

buffs.name: Eggnog
buffs.source: Dropped by Presents obtained during the Christmas seasonal event
buffs.effect: When used, it restores 80 health and inflicts Potion Sickness for 40 seconds. This duration can be reduced via the Philosopher's Stone or Charm of Myths.

buffs.name: Roasted Bird
buffs.source: Crafted at a Cooking Pot or Cauldron
buffs.station: Cooking Pot or Cauldron
buffs.effect: This lasts for 10 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Endurance Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at a Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask

buffs.name: Heartreach Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at a Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff increases the pickup range of life recovery Hearts by 15.625 tiles, from 2.625 tiles to a total of 18.25 tiles. This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Ironskin Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at a Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table, or dropped by slimes.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask

buffs.name: Regeneration Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at a Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table, or found in Underground chests.
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask

buffs.name: Rage Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at a Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask

buffs.name: Sharpening Station
buffs.source: Found in Underground Cabins in the Underground Jungle, or bought from the Merchant in Hardmode.
buffs.why: Melee attacks and projectiles gain 12 armor penetration.

buffs.name: Thorns Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at a Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask
buffs.effect: The buff inflicts a knockback of 10 (Extremely strong) on enemies that come into contact with the player, and deals 100% of their damage to them. [ 1 ] This lasts for 8 minutes, but can be canceled at any time by right-clicking the icon (), by selecting the icon using Cycle Next/Previous Buff and then pressing Remove Buff (), or by double-tapping the buff icon ().

buffs.name: Wrath Potion
buffs.source: Crafted at a Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table
buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask

items.name: Extra jump
items.why: Any double-jump bottle works here: Cloud in a Bottle (Underground and Cavern Chests), Blizzard in a Bottle (Frozen Chests), Sandstorm in a Bottle (Pyramid Chests), or Tsunami in a Bottle (Ocean Chests).

items.name: Frog Leg
items.source: Fished up in any body of water, and craftable by hand.
items.why: Increases the player's jump speed and fall resistance.

items.name: Hermes Boots
items.source: Found in Underground and Cavern Chests, and craftable by hand.
items.why: Increases movement speed while running.

items.name: Magiluminescence
items.source: Crafted at Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
items.why: Increases the player's movement speed by 15%, and their acceleration (and deceleration) by 75%. This movement speed buff no longer applies if the player is not grounded.

items.name: Gladiator's Locket
items.source: Found in the Marble Cave shrine, then purchasable from the Shady Salesman for 25 gold during a Full Moon.
items.why: This is difficult to obtain, and only one can be obtained per world.
items.effect: When equipped, it makes enemies drop healing orbs upon death which are affected by gravity. The healing orbs restore 10 health when touched and disappear after 20 seconds.

items.name: Ilmeris' Spark
items.why: This is best on worms and other multi-hit scenarios.
items.effect: When equipped, it causes the player to release 8 gravity-affected sparks around them when harmed by any source of damage. These sparks linger for 2 seconds, partially ignore immunity frames, and deal 6 base damage, which is boosted by the player's highest class' damage.

items.name: Rover Drive
items.effect: When equipped for 10 seconds without taking damage, a protective matrix covers its user, which grants 20 matrix durability. If the player gets hit, durability is lost instead of health by the amount of damage taken.

items.name: Black Glass Band
items.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
items.effect: While equipped, it releases an obsidian strike upon enemy hits that deals 20 typeless damage and always critically strikes, with a 5 second cooldown that is halved if the enemy is killed with the strike. The strike's damage value scales with the player's highest class' damage.

items.name: Craw Carapace
items.source: Dropped by Crawdads and sold by the Skeleton Merchant during a waning crescent or waxing crescent for 12 gold
items.effect: While equipped, it increases damage by 7%. Enemies that deal contact damage to the player take 20 / 40 / 60 damage, inflicting them with the Crumbling debuff.

items.name: Feral Claws
items.source: Found in Jungle chests or Jungle Crates
items.why: Increases melee attack speed and grants autoswing to melee weapons.

items.name: Shark Tooth Necklace
items.source: Drops from Blood Zombies and Dripplers during a Blood Moon
items.why: Provides all weapons with 5 unconditional armor penetration. Can be stacked with or upgraded into the Stinger Necklace.

tools.name: Monstrous Knives
tools.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
tools.effect: When used, the player throws a spread of 3-4 gravity-affected knives that heal the player for 5% to 10% of the damage dealt. The knives fade away after a short amount of time, losing 10% of its damage and knockback every 0.5 seconds, then disappear into cosmetic red dust when fully transparent.

tools.name: Wulfrum Controller
tools.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
tools.effect: When used with its primary function (left-click), it summons a Wulfrum Droid minion that floats by the player and attacks nearby enemies by firing green energy bolts that cannot pierce but can curve towards nearby enemies. The droid waits a random time from 0.49-1.83 seconds between shots, and recoils in the opposite direction of its shot while shooting.

weapons.name: Demon Bow
weapons.source: Crafted at Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
weapons.why: Corruption bow requiring Shadow Scales dropped by the Eater of Worlds.

weapons.name: Tendon Bow
weapons.source: Crafted at Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
weapons.why: Crimson counterpart to the Demon Bow.

weapons.name: Flintlock Pistol
weapons.source: Purchased from the Arms Dealer (5 GC)
weapons.why: Basic pistol sold by the Arms Dealer before any boss.

weapons.name: Paintball Gun
weapons.source: Purchased from the Painter
weapons.why: Fires a three-shot burst of arcing paintballs and uses no ammunition.

weapons.name: Spark Spreader
weapons.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
weapons.why: Wulfrum-set gun option
weapons.effect: When used, it fires bursts of 4 short-ranged orange sparks with a 0.2 second delay in between. The sparks inflict the On Fire! debuff and pierce three enemies.

weapons.name: Minishark
weapons.source: Purchased from the Arms Dealer (35 GC)
weapons.why: Fast-firing gun sold by the Arms Dealer before any boss.

weapons.name: Slagfire Douser
weapons.effect: Sprays bursts of molten pollen that ignore 10 defense and coat enemies in Searing Lava.
weapons.why: Molten-pollen flamethrower.
weapons.source: Found in Brimstone Crates and Slag Crates, or in Ashen Chests in the Brimstone Crag

weapons.name: Boomstick
weapons.source: Found in Ivy Chests and Jungle/Bramble Crates
weapons.why: Pre-Hardmode shotgun that fires a spread of bullets, found in the Jungle.

weapons.name: Blood Rain Bow
weapons.source: Dropped by Wandering Eye Fish and Zombie Merman (Blood Moon fishing)
weapons.why: Fires arrows in an arc that rain down from above.

armor.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil

armor.headpieceBonus: +10% ranged damage · +4% ranged critical strike chance

armor.name: Fossil armor
armor.source: Crafted at Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
armor.effect: +5% ranged damage · +8% ranged critical strike chance · +20% ammo conservation
armor.desc: Fossil armor is a pre-Hardmode ranged armor set consisting of the Fossil Helmet, Fossil Plate, and Fossil Greaves.

ammo.name: Flash Round
ammo.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
ammo.effect: They can bounce off enemies and tiles and creates a small flash which knocks away enemies. They become affected by gravity after bouncing, and can bounce off tiles twice, gaining 13% damage or +2 flat damage on each bounce, whichever is greater.

ammo.name: Frostburn Arrow
ammo.effect: It has a 1/3 (33.33%) chance to inflict the Frostburn debuff for 3 seconds on enemies.

ammo.name: Jester's Arrow
ammo.effect: It is unaffected by gravity and can pierce an infinite number of enemies, and its damage decreases by 10% per each enemy pierced.

ammo.name: Silver Bullet
ammo.effect: It deals 2 more damage and is slightly faster than Musket Balls. It also deals 300% damage to Werewolves. [ 1 ]

ammo.name: Tungsten Bullet
ammo.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
ammo.effect: It deals 2 more damage and is slightly faster than Musket Balls. When either Musket Balls or Tungsten Bullets are fired with certain guns, they will be converted into a special projectile (e.g. the Uzi converting them into High Velocity Bullets).

ammo.name: Unholy Arrow
ammo.effect: It can pierce 4 enemies, and its damage decreases by 5% per enemy pierced.

weapons.why: Places a lingering blood cloud that rains piercing droplets downward onto enemies below.

weapons.name: Thunder Zapper
weapons.source: Found in Sandstone Chests and Oasis/Mirage Crates (Desert)
weapons.why: Fires an electric bolt that pierces one enemy, found in the Desert.

weapons.name: Veering Wind
weapons.source: Crafted at a Bookcase
weapons.why: solid primary magic option
weapons.effect: When used with its primary fire (⚒ Use / Attack), it fires an even ring of 12 fast air waves which travel outwards from the player and deal heavy knockback. When used with its secondary fire (⚷ Open / Activate), it instead fires frost waves that inflict the Frostburn and Frozen debuffs, with 20% knockback, 25% velocity, and 50% attack speed compared to the air waves.

weapons.source: Dropped by Shadow Orbs (Corruption); found in Corrupt Crates
weapons.why: Projects a piercing line of thorns through blocks and enemies.

weapons.name: Demon Scythe
weapons.source: Dropped by Demons and Voodoo Demons in the Underworld
weapons.why: Fires accelerating sickle projectiles that pierce up to five enemies.

weapons.name: Frost Bolt
weapons.source: Crafted at a Bookcase
weapons.effect: Casts a bouncing ball of frost that bursts on impact and inflicts Frostburn.

weapons.name: Mana Rose
weapons.source: Crafted at an Iron or Lead Anvil
weapons.effect: Casts a mana flower that explodes into homing and non-homing petals.
weapons.why: Homing petal wand.

weapons.name: Icicle Staff
weapons.source: Crafted at an Iron or Lead Anvil
weapons.effect: Casts icicles from the sky that shatter on impact.
weapons.why: Falling-icicle wand.

items.name: Frog Leg
items.source: Fished up in any body of water, and craftable by hand.
items.why: Increases the player's jump speed and fall resistance.

items.name: Hermes Boots
items.source: Found in Underground and Cavern Chests, and craftable by hand.
items.why: Increases movement speed while running.

items.name: Magiluminescence
items.source: Crafted at Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
items.why: Increases the player's movement speed by 15%, and their acceleration (and deceleration) by 75%. This movement speed buff no longer applies if the player is not grounded.

items.name: Gladiator's Locket
items.source: Found in the Marble Cave shrine, then purchasable from the Shady Salesman for 25 gold during a Full Moon.
items.why: This is difficult to obtain, and only one can be obtained per world.
items.effect: When equipped, it makes enemies drop healing orbs upon death which are affected by gravity. The healing orbs restore 10 health when touched and disappear after 20 seconds.

items.name: Ilmeris' Spark
items.why: This is best on worms and other multi-hit scenarios.
items.effect: When equipped, it causes the player to release 8 gravity-affected sparks around them when harmed by any source of damage. These sparks linger for 2 seconds, partially ignore immunity frames, and deal 6 base damage, which is boosted by the player's highest class' damage.

items.name: Rover Drive
items.effect: When equipped for 10 seconds without taking damage, a protective matrix covers its user, which grants 20 matrix durability. If the player gets hit, durability is lost instead of health by the amount of damage taken.

items.name: Band of Starpower
items.source: Dropped by Shadow Orbs (Corruption); found in Corrupt and Defiled Crates
items.why: +20 max mana for early casters.
items.station: Tinkerer's Workshop and Ecto Mist (Desktop, Console and Mobile versions)
items.effect: Increases maximum mana by 20

items.name: Black Glass Band
items.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
items.effect: While equipped, it releases an obsidian strike upon enemy hits that deals 20 typeless damage and always critically strikes, with a 5 second cooldown that is halved if the enemy is killed with the strike. The strike's damage value scales with the player's highest class' damage.

items.name: Craw Carapace
items.source: Dropped by Crawdads and sold by the Skeleton Merchant during a waning crescent or waxing crescent for 12 gold
items.effect: While equipped, it increases damage by 7%. Enemies that deal contact damage to the player take 20 / 40 / 60 damage, inflicting them with the Crumbling debuff.

items.name: Shark Tooth Necklace
items.source: Drops from Blood Zombies and Dripplers during a Blood Moon
items.why: Provides all weapons with 5 unconditional armor penetration. Can be stacked with or upgraded into the Stinger Necklace.

tools.name: Wulfrum Controller
tools.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
tools.effect: When used with its primary function (left-click), it summons a Wulfrum Droid minion that floats by the player and attacks nearby enemies by firing green energy bolts that cannot pierce but can curve towards nearby enemies. The droid waits a random time from 0.49-1.83 seconds between shots, and recoils in the opposite direction of its shot while shooting.

weapons.name: Enchanted Knife Staff
weapons.source: Found in underground Gold Chests or from Golden or Titanium Crates
weapons.why: primary minion, strong ranged summon damage
weapons.effect: When used, it summons a floating knife that float over the player's head. While an enemy is nearby, it swings itself back and forth at a close distance from the enemy, shooting a knife beam that is unaffected by gravity and can pass through tiles.

weapons.name: Stormjaw Staff
weapons.source: Dropped by Stormlions
weapons.why: solid alternative minion
weapons.effect: When used, it summons a miniature Stormlion minion. It runs on the ground and aggressively rams enemies back and forth, does not deal contact damage but creates damaging sparks in contact with enemies.

weapons.name: Sun Spirit Staff
weapons.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
weapons.why: alternative minion option
weapons.effect: When used, it summons a Solar Spirit minion above the player's head that fires non-piercing yellow energy beams at nearby enemies once every 0.83 seconds. Unlike most minions, only one Solar Spirit can be summoned at a time.

weapons.name: Squirrel Squire Staff
weapons.source: Obtained from the Starter Bag
weapons.why: alternative sentry
weapons.effect: Is also obtained from the Starter Bag. When used, it summons a stationary squirrel sentry at the nearest block to the player's location. If there are no blocks directly underneath it, it will start falling.

weapons.name: Leather Whip
weapons.source: Purchased from the Zoologist (10 Gold)
weapons.why: Bought from the Zoologist and directs minions onto the struck target.

weapons.name: Snapthorn
weapons.effect: A whip that tags enemies and grants a minion attack-speed boost.

weapons.name: Antlion Skewer
weapons.source: Dropped by Antlions
weapons.why: first-listed spam rogue weapon, strong sustained DPS
weapons.effect: When used, it throws a skewered Antlion javelin that is unaffected by gravity. After 0.25 seconds, the Antlion spits a sand ball in its direction which deals 50% damage, then accelerates for the next 0.5 seconds.

weapons.name: Contaminated Bile
weapons.source: Dropped by Gnashers
weapons.why: solid area-denial spam option; first-listed stealth strike option
weapons.effect: It throws a bile flask that shatters into a lingering irradiated cloud on hit.

weapons.name: Gilded Dagger
weapons.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
weapons.effect: When used, it throws a fast-moving golden dagger that ricochets towards the nearest enemy after hitting the first enemy. The dagger pierces once and breaks on tile contact.

weapons.name: Gleaming Dagger
weapons.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
weapons.effect: When used, it throws a fast-moving platinum dagger that ricochets towards the nearest enemy after hitting the first enemy. The dagger pierces once and breaks on tile contact.

weapons.name: Urchin Stinger
weapons.source: Dropped by Aquatic Urchins
weapons.why: alternative spam weapon
weapons.effect: When used, they fire an urchin stinger that travels a short distance before being affected by gravity. The urchin stinger pierces once and inflicts the Poisoned debuff on hit.

weapons.name: Wulfrum Knife
weapons.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
weapons.why: early spam knife; stealth knife
weapons.effect: When used with its primary fire (⚒ Use / Attack), it throws a set of three knives in quick succession. The knives are affected by gravity and do not pierce.

weapons.name: Iron Francisca
weapons.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
weapons.effect: It throws a gravity affected axe that travels a short distance before falling to the ground. Each axe's damage has a 2x damage increase for the first 0.25 seconds after being thrown.

weapons.name: Lead Tomahawk
weapons.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
weapons.effect: It throws a gravity affected axe that travels a short distance before falling to the ground. Each axe's damage has a 2x damage increase for the first 0.25 seconds after being thrown.

armor.name: Desert Prowler armor
armor.source: Crafted at Loom
armor.why: first-listed rogue armor at this tier
armor.effect: +50 maximum stealth · Sandsmoke Bomb - Armor Set Bonus to shroud yourself in a small cloud of sand · While the sand cloud is active, gain increased mobility but heavily reduced defense · Using a rogue weapon instantly dispels the sand cloak, but guarantees a supercrit for 200% damage · The supercrit applies only as long as the resulting hit wouldn't exceed 200 damage · Landing the killing blow on an enemy with this shot shortens the ability's cooldown to 2 seconds
armor.desc: Desert Prowler armor is a Pre-Hardmode rogue armor set.

armor.name: Gladiator armor
armor.source: Dropped by Hoplites
armor.effect: Grants immunity to knockback
armor.desc: Gladiator armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Gladiator Helmet, Gladiator Breastplate, and Gladiator Leggings. Each piece has a 1/21 (4.76%) chance of being dropped by Hoplites.

armor.name: Gold armor
armor.source: Crafted at Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
armor.why: Worth wearing if you find the ore, but not worth mining for: the first boss drops a better set.
armor.effect: +3 defense · Enemies have a 2% chance to drop 1 gold coin, and bosses always drop an extra 3 gold coin · +1% critical strike chance per 5 gold coin in inventory, capped at +5%
armor.desc: Gold armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Gold Helmet, Gold Chainmail, and Gold Greaves. The full set grants 16 defense while equipped.

armor.name: Platinum armor
armor.source: Crafted at Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil

items.why: Increases the player's movement speed by 15%, and their acceleration (and deceleration) by 75%. This movement speed buff no longer applies if the player is not grounded.

items.name: Gladiator's Locket
items.source: Found in the Marble Cave shrine, then purchasable from the Shady Salesman for 25 gold during a Full Moon.
items.why: This is difficult to obtain, and only one can be obtained per world.
items.effect: When equipped, it makes enemies drop healing orbs upon death which are affected by gravity. The healing orbs restore 10 health when touched and disappear after 20 seconds.

items.name: Ilmeris' Spark
items.why: This is best on worms and other multi-hit scenarios.
items.effect: When equipped, it causes the player to release 8 gravity-affected sparks around them when harmed by any source of damage. These sparks linger for 2 seconds, partially ignore immunity frames, and deal 6 base damage, which is boosted by the player's highest class' damage.

items.name: Rover Drive
items.effect: When equipped for 10 seconds without taking damage, a protective matrix covers its user, which grants 20 matrix durability. If the player gets hit, durability is lost instead of health by the amount of damage taken.

items.name: Black Glass Band
items.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
items.effect: While equipped, it releases an obsidian strike upon enemy hits that deals 20 typeless damage and always critically strikes, with a 5 second cooldown that is halved if the enemy is killed with the strike. The strike's damage value scales with the player's highest class' damage.

items.name: Craw Carapace
items.source: Dropped by Crawdads and sold by the Skeleton Merchant during a waning crescent or waxing crescent for 12 gold
items.effect: While equipped, it increases damage by 7%. Enemies that deal contact damage to the player take 20 / 40 / 60 damage, inflicting them with the Crumbling debuff.

items.name: Shark Tooth Necklace
items.source: Drops from Blood Zombies and Dripplers during a Blood Moon
items.why: Provides all weapons with 5 unconditional armor penetration. Can be stacked with or upgraded into the Stinger Necklace.

items.name: Coin of Deceit
items.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
items.effect: When equipped, it increases rogue critical strike chance by 6% and makes stealth strikes only require 90% of the player's maximum stealth to perform and consume 90% of the player's maximum stealth when performed.

items.name: Scuttler's Jewel
items.effect: When equipped, it causes rogue projectiles to spawn a stationary floating jewel spike on the first hit of a stealth strike that deals 16 rogue damage. It can also be used at an Extractinator to obtain gems.

tools.name: Wulfrum Controller
tools.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
tools.effect: When used with its primary function (left-click), it summons a Wulfrum Droid minion that floats by the player and attacks nearby enemies by firing green energy bolts that cannot pierce but can curve towards nearby enemies. The droid waits a random time from 0.49-1.83 seconds between shots, and recoils in the opposite direction of its shot while shooting.

weapons.name: Bladecrest Oathsword
weapons.source: Dropped by Demons and Voodoo Demons in The Underworld
weapons.effect: It throws a sword that sticks into enemies, with a max of 3 being able to be stuck into a single enemy. If another is stuck, the oldest one will be launched out.

weapons.name: Old Lord Claymore
weapons.source: Dropped by Bone Serpents
weapons.why: strong projectile melee sword, primary pick
weapons.effect: When used, it performs a slow, high knockback slash with a custom animation that inflicts the Hellfire debuff.

weapons.name: Blade of Grass
weapons.source: Crafted at Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
weapons.why: Fires a homing Leaf Blade projectile on each swing.

weapons.name: Depth Crusher
weapons.source: Dropped by Viperfish, or found in the Void Chest in the Abyss Shrine
weapons.effect: Tosses a heavy crusher that ricochets off tiles and enemies and releases water energy, inflicting Riptide.
weapons.why: Ricocheting abyssal crusher.

weapons.name: Malaise
weapons.source: Crafted at Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
weapons.why: Corruption counterpart of the Crimson's Artery.

weapons.name: Artery
weapons.source: Crafted at Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
weapons.why: Crimson counterpart of the Corruption's Malaise.

weapons.name: Thorn Chakram
weapons.source: Crafted at Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
weapons.why: Bouncing chakram that inflicts Poisoned.

weapons.name: Basher
weapons.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
weapons.why: primary melee weapon at this tier
weapons.effect: When used, it swings back and forth in almost a complete circle toward the cursor and inflicts the Irradiated debuff, while also knocking the player back in the process.

weapons.name: Sahara Slicers
weapons.source: Dropped by the Desert Scourge
weapons.why: solid boomerang alternative
weapons.effect: When swung, a pair of dual daggers rapidly stab in front of the player. Hitting an enemy with one of the daggers will spawn 2 bolts which appear behind the player, up to a maximum of 10.

weapons.name: Seashine Sword
weapons.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
weapons.why: reliable broadsword option
weapons.effect: When swung, it fires a glowing aquamarine sword beam that emits glowing particles, deals damage and travels indefinitely, disappearing upon hitting a block or an enemy.

weapons.name: Trimarang
weapons.source: Crafted at Work Bench
weapons.why: Throws three boomerangs at once.

weapons.name: Urchin Mace
weapons.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
weapons.why: flail option
weapons.effect: When used, the player starts spinning the mace around, creating a whirlpool around themselves. If the player stops using the weapon after 1.83 or more seconds of spinning, they launch the whirlpool towards their mouse cursor, which pierces infinitely, deals double damage, and travels a short distance before popping, emitting glowing water dust in a large radius.

armor.name: Victide armor
armor.source: Crafted at Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
armor.effect: +5% damage reduction · +5% critical strike chance · +8% movement speed · While submerged in liquids: +5 defense, +10% damage reduction, +1.5 HP/s, +30% movement speed · Reduced breath loss in the Abyss · Move freely through liquids · 10% chance on attack to fire a returning seashell (double weapon damage, softcap 46, true damage, no crit; not from weapons of Yellow rarity or higher)
armor.headpieceBonus: +5% melee damage · +10% melee damage while submerged in liquids · +200 aggro

armor.name: Platinum armor
armor.source: Crafted at Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
armor.why: No set bonus. Worth wearing if you find the ore, but not worth mining for: the first boss drops a better set.
armor.desc: Platinum armor is a pre-Hardmode armor set consisting of the Platinum Helmet, Platinum Chainmail, and Platinum Greaves. The full set grants 20 defense while equipped.
armor.effect: +4 defense · +10% damage reduction

accessories.effect: Grants flight · The wearer can run super fast

accessories.name: Sandstorm in a Balloon
accessories.effect: Grants an improved double jump · Increases jump height

accessories.why: Allows the player to fly briefly and glide (and negates fall damage).

accessories.source: Found in Jungle chests or Jungle Crates
accessories.why: Increases melee attack speed and grants autoswing to melee weapons.

buffs.station: Placed Bottle or Alchemy Table or Alchemy Flask

buffs.source: Purchased from the Skeleton Merchant during certain moon phases for 5 SC
buffs.effect: When used, it restores 70–120 health, inflicts 40–70 seconds of Potion Sickness, and has a 3/5 (60%) chance to grant up to 4 seconds of invincibility. The duration of Potion Sickness can be reduced via the Philosopher's Stone or Charm of Myths.

buffs.station: Cooking Pot or Cauldron

weapons.name: Acid Gun
weapons.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
weapons.why: steady ranged magic damage
weapons.effect: When used, it fires a volley of three acid streams that dissipate on collision with tiles or after piercing once. The acid streams inflict the Irradiated debuff.

weapons.name: Crimson Rod
weapons.source: Destroyed from Crimson Hearts, or fished in Crimson/Hematic Crates
weapons.why: Places a lingering blood cloud that rains piercing droplets downward onto enemies below.

weapons.name: Gray Zapinator
weapons.source: Purchased from the Traveling Merchant (pre-Hardmode)
weapons.why: Fires an erratic light beam that ricochets and varies in size.

weapons.name: Sparkling Empress
weapons.source: Fished in the Sunken Sea after defeating Desert Scourge
weapons.why: strong sustained damage
weapons.effect: When used, it briefly charges, then releases a concentrated light-blue laser that pierces infinitely. Upon killing an enemy, they explode into two to three prism shards that shoot out in random directions, dealing 20% of the weapon's base damage.

weapons.name: Thunder Zapper
weapons.source: Found in Sandstone Chests and Oasis/Mirage Crates (Desert)
weapons.why: Fires an electric bolt that pierces one enemy, found in the Desert.

items.why: Any double-jump bottle works here: Cloud in a Bottle (Underground and Cavern Chests), Blizzard in a Bottle (Frozen Chests), Sandstorm in a Bottle (Pyramid Chests), or Tsunami in a Bottle (Ocean Chests).

items.name: Fledgling Wings
items.source: Found in Skyware Chests, Sky Crates, and Azure Crates, and craftable by hand.
items.why: Allows the player to fly briefly and glide (and negates fall damage).

items.name: Frog Leg
items.source: Fished up in any body of water, and craftable by hand.
items.why: Increases the player's jump speed and fall resistance.

items.name: Lightning Boots
items.why: Sprint and flight movement in one slot, accelerating faster and reaching a higher top speed than Spectre Boots.

items.name: Magiluminescence
items.source: Crafted at Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
items.why: Increases the player's movement speed by 15%, and their acceleration (and deceleration) by 75%. This movement speed buff no longer applies if the player is not grounded.

items.name: Shield of Cthulhu
items.source: Found in Treasure Bag (Eye of Cthulhu)
items.why: Grants a short dash that damages enemies (double-tap a direction).

items.name: Fungal Clump
items.effect: When equipped, it summons a Fungal Clump minion that attaches to enemies, damaging them and spawning blue healing orbs that home in on the player and heal them for 25% of the damage the minion deals.

items.name: Brain of Confusion
items.source: Found in Treasure Bag (Brain of Cthulhu), and craftable at a Tinkerer's Workshop.
items.why: 16.67% chance to dodge an attack when hit, which grants +10% crit and summon damage for 4s; taking damage also has a 60% chance to confuse nearby enemies.

items.name: Crown Jewel
items.effect: +0.5 HP/s life regen · Reduces damage over time taken by 2 HP/s

items.name: Gladiator's Locket
items.source: Found in the Marble Cave shrine, then purchasable from the Shady Salesman for 25 gold during a Full Moon.
items.why: This is difficult to obtain, and only one can be obtained per world.
items.effect: When equipped, it makes enemies drop healing orbs upon death which are affected by gravity. The healing orbs restore 10 health when touched and disappear after 20 seconds.

items.name: Unholy Tonic
items.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
items.why: Use which matches your world evil.
items.effect: When equipped, it grants +3 defense while in The Corruption. It also grants immunity to the Brain Rot debuff.

items.name: Vicious Tonic
items.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
items.why: Use which matches your world evil.
items.effect: When equipped, it grants +3 defense while in The Crimson. It also grants immunity to the Burning Blood debuff.

items.name: Worm Scarf
items.source: Found in Treasure Bag (Eater of Worlds), and craftable at a Tinkerer's Workshop.
items.why: Reduces all damage taken by 17%.

items.name: Craw Carapace
items.source: Dropped by Crawdads and sold by the Skeleton Merchant during a waning crescent or waxing crescent for 12 gold
items.effect: While equipped, it increases damage by 7%. Enemies that deal contact damage to the player take 20 / 40 / 60 damage, inflicting them with the Crumbling debuff.

items.name: Protolith Bangle
items.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
items.effect: While equipped, it releases a marble shatter upon enemy hits with ranged weapons that deals 30 typeless damage and always critically strikes, with a 7 second cooldown. The shatter's damage value scales with the player's highest class' damage.

items.name: Scions Curio
items.effect: Ranged hits increase the effectiveness of Irradiated · Irradiated damage over time scales off of your ranged damage and crit chance · On kill, enemies burst, spreading Irradiated · Taking damage causes the curio to explode in retaliation · Current Irradiated damage: [DAMAGE]

tools.name: Brittle Star Staff
tools.effect: When used, it summons a Brittle Star minion, which follows the player and attacks enemies by dashing at them to deal damage. Brittle stars hit up to 4 enemies before shattering, quickly regenerating afterwards.

tools.name: Wulfrum Controller
tools.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
tools.effect: When used with its primary function (left-click), it summons a Wulfrum Droid minion that floats by the player and attacks nearby enemies by firing green energy bolts that cannot pierce but can curve towards nearby enemies. The droid waits a random time from 0.49-1.83 seconds between shots, and recoils in the opposite direction of its shot while shooting.

ammo.name: Jester's Arrow
ammo.effect: It is unaffected by gravity and can pierce an infinite number of enemies, and its damage decreases by 10% per each enemy pierced.

ammo.name: Flash Round
ammo.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
ammo.effect: They can bounce off enemies and tiles and creates a small flash which knocks away enemies. They become affected by gravity after bouncing, and can bounce off tiles twice, gaining 13% damage or +2 flat damage on each bounce, whichever is greater.

ammo.name: Meteor Shot
ammo.effect: When fired, it can either bounce from a solid block once or pierce through one enemy.

ammo.name: Flare
ammo.source: Purchased from the Merchant, or crafted
ammo.effect: Ammo for the Flare Gun and flare-based weapons; lights up the area.
ammo.why: Cheap flare-gun ammo for early flame weapons.

weapons.name: Demon Scythe
weapons.source: Dropped by Demons and Voodoo Demons in the Underworld
weapons.why: Fires accelerating sickle projectiles that pierce up to five enemies.

weapons.name: Flare Bolt
weapons.source: Crafted at a Bookcase
weapons.effect: When used, it fires a slow-moving ball of fire that travels in a straight line, is unaffected by gravity, inflicts the On Fire! debuff on hit, and can pierce or bounce off blocks three times before dissipating.

weapons.name: Hellwing Staff
weapons.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
weapons.effect: When used, it spawns 4 non-piercing flaming bats that go through tiles and quickly dissipate after spawning. The way the bats spawn depends on where the cursor spawns them.

weapons.name: Space Gun
weapons.source: Crafted at Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
weapons.why: Rapidly fires fast-moving lasers and costs no mana with Meteor armor.

weapons.name: The Cauldron
weapons.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
weapons.effect: When used, the player holds the cauldron overhead which lobs gravity-affected lava bombs towards the cursor. Upon impact with a tile or enemy, the lava bombs cause a small explosion that deals 66% of the weapon's damage as well as erupting into 3 smaller bombs.

weapons.name: Aquamarine Staff
weapons.source: Crafted at an Iron or Lead Anvil
weapons.effect: Shoots two blue bolts that do not pierce or pass through tiles.
weapons.why: Twin-bolt gem wand.

weapons.name: Gray Zapinator
weapons.source: Purchased from the Traveling Merchant (pre-Hardmode)
weapons.why: Fires an erratic light beam that ricochets and varies in size.

armor.name: Meteor armor
armor.source: Crafted at Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
armor.why: Space Gun costs 0 mana, so it pairs with that weapon specifically.
armor.effect: +27% magic damage · Reduces the mana cost of the Space Gun, Laser Rifle, Gray Zapinator, and Orange Zapinator to 0 · Immunity to meteorite projectiles during the Meteor Shower event · Leaves behind a trail of flames.
armor.desc: Meteor armor is a pre-Hardmode mage armor set consisting of the Meteor Helmet, Meteor Suit, and Meteor Leggings.

armor.name: Jungle armor
armor.source: Crafted at Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
armor.effect: +6% magic damage · +12% magic critical strike chance · +80 maximum mana · +16% mana cost reduction · Emits grass particles while moving.
armor.desc: Jungle armor is a pre-Hardmode mage armor set consisting of the Jungle Shirt, Jungle Hat, and Jungle Pants.

weapons.name: Scab Ripper
weapons.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
weapons.effect: When used, it summons a tiny Blood Crawler minion that flies around and latches onto nearby enemies. When latched, it deals contact damage in addition to spawning 2 damaging blood particles from the sky that pierce once.

weapons.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
weapons.why: Summons a spinning scorching flower that fires a piercing flaming cind

weapons.name: Deathstare Rod
weapons.source: Dropped by the Eye of Cthulhu
weapons.why: solid alternative minion
weapons.effect: When used, it summons a tiny floating eyeball above the player's head that fires lasers at nearby enemies once every second. On hit, the laser deals damage in a tiny area of effect.

weapons.name: Polyp Launcher
weapons.source: Purchased from Sea King for 2 gold
weapons.why: primary sentry option
weapons.effect: When used, it summons a grounded polyp sentry which inaccurately fires gravity-affected balls of coral at nearby enemies. On hit, the coral chunk bursts into 1-4 fragments which deals half as much damage and knockback.

weapons.name: Vile Feeder
weapons.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
weapons.effect: When used, it summons a tiny Eater of Souls minion, which flies around and latches onto nearby enemies. When latched, it does not deal contact damage to enemies but releases several homing tiny eaters similar to the Scourge of the Corruptor.

armor.name: Obsidian armor
armor.source: Crafted at Hellforge
armor.why: Whip range +30%, whip speed +15%, summon damage +15%.

armor.desc: Obsidian armor is a pre-Hardmode summoner armor set consisting of the Obsidian Outlaw Hat, Obsidian Longcoat, and Obsidian Pants.

weapons.effect: It throws a sword that sticks into enemies, with a max of 3 being able to be stuck into a single enemy. If another is stuck, the oldest one will be launched out.

weapons.name: Goldplume Spear

weapons.name: Vein Burster

weapons.name: Wind Blade
weapons.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil

weapons.name: Broken Biome Blade
weapons.source: Crafted at an Iron or Lead Anvil

weapons.why: Biome-attuned broadsword.

weapons.source: Crafted at an Iron or Lead Anvil

weapons.why: Homing blood spear.

weapons.why: Feather-firing yoyo.

weapons.name: Feather Knife
weapons.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
weapons.why: first-listed spam rogue weapon, steady rapid damage
weapons.effect: When used, it throws a gravity affected knife that periodically releases homing explosive feathers. The feather and explosion deal 5% and 50% of the weapon's damage respectively.

weapons.name: Hardened Honeycomb

weapons.why: alternate spam thrown weapon
weapons.effect: When used, it throws honeycomb projectiles that are slightly affected by gravity and shatter into 2 fragments upon collision with an enemy or tile. The honeycomb fragments fly in random directions and deal 100% of the weapon's base damage.

weapons.name: Meteor Fist
weapons.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
weapons.why: alternate spam thrown weapon
weapons.effect: When used, it releases a rocket fist which connects to the player via a wire. After 1 second, the fist begins to accelerate and home towards the cursor's position, leaving a fiery trail behind it.

weapons.effect: When thrown, the disk detects the nearest enemy and fires lasers towards them, accelerating further the longer it is out. These lasers do not directly damage enemies, and instead accumulate laser burn for each time they hit an enemy, equal to 20% of the disk's damage, which deals direct damage after enough time has passed or enough lasers have hit the enemy.

weapons.name: Tooth Ball

items.effect: While equipped, it increases damage by 7%. Enemies that deal contact damage to the player take 20 / 40 / 60 damage, inflicting them with the Crumbling debuff.

items.name: Protolith Bangle
items.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
items.effect: While equipped, it releases a marble shatter upon enemy hits with ranged weapons that deals 30 typeless damage and always critically strikes, with a 7 second cooldown. The shatter's damage value scales with the player's highest class' damage.

tools.name: Brittle Star Staff
tools.effect: When used, it summons a Brittle Star minion, which follows the player and attacks enemies by dashing at them to deal damage. Brittle stars hit up to 4 enemies before shattering, quickly regenerating afterwards.

tools.name: Wulfrum Controller
tools.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
tools.effect: When used with its primary function (left-click), it summons a Wulfrum Droid minion that floats by the player and attacks nearby enemies by firing green energy bolts that cannot pierce but can curve towards nearby enemies. The droid waits a random time from 0.49-1.83 seconds between shots, and recoils in the opposite direction of its shot while shooting.

ammo.name: Jester's Arrow
ammo.effect: It is unaffected by gravity and can pierce an infinite number of enemies, and its damage decreases by 10% per each enemy pierced.

ammo.name: Flash Round
ammo.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
ammo.effect: They can bounce off enemies and tiles and creates a small flash which knocks away enemies. They become affected by gravity after bouncing, and can bounce off tiles twice, gaining 13% damage or +2 flat damage on each bounce, whichever is greater.

ammo.name: Meteor Shot
ammo.effect: When fired, it can either bounce from a solid block once or pierce through one enemy.

ammo.name: Snowball
ammo.source: Gathered from Snow Blocks, or bought from the Traveling Merchant
ammo.why: Ammo for snowball weapons like the Flurrystorm Cannon.
ammo.effect: Ammunition for snowball launchers.

weapons.name: Abyssal Tome
weapons.source: Dropped by The Slime God
weapons.why: first-listed primary magic weapon at this tier
weapons.effect: When used, it fires a slow-moving purple glob that passes through tiles and is not affected by gravity and will slowly decelerate before stopping in place. After hitting an enemy twice or after 5 seconds from being shot, it will explode, dealing damage in a small radius.

weapons.name: Aqua Scepter
weapons.source: Found in Gold Chests / Golden Lock Boxes
weapons.why: Sprays a stream of water droplets that pierce enemies.

weapons.name: Blood Bath
weapons.source: Dropped by The Perforators
weapons.why: area magic weapon option
weapons.effect: When used, it spawns 2-3 blood raindrops from the sky that pierce once but cannot pass through tiles. The raindrops inflict the Burning Blood debuff.

weapons.name: Demon Scythe
weapons.source: Dropped by Demons and Voodoo Demons in the Underworld
weapons.why: Fires accelerating sickle projectiles that pierce up to five enemies.

weapons.name: Eldritch Tome
weapons.source: Dropped by The Slime God
weapons.why: homing magic weapon
weapons.effect: When used, it releases red tendrils which bend in random directions, similarly to the Shadowflame Hex Doll.

weapons.name: Night's Ray
weapons.source: Crafted at a Demon Altar or Crimson Altar
weapons.why: multi-star magic weapon with high DPS
weapons.effect: When used, it fires a purple beam that pierces ten times. When the beam hits an enemy, it spawns 4 four short-range particle beams to damage nearby enemies.

weapons.name: Black Anurian
weapons.source: Found in Ancient Treasure Chests in the Abyss, or in Hydrothermal Crates
weapons.effect: Spews bubbles and homing plankton.
weapons.why: Homing bubble-and-plankton magic weapon.

weapons.name: Book of Skulls
weapons.source: Dropped by Skeletron
weapons.why: Fires slow homing skull projectiles that pierce twice.

weapons.source: Found in Rusty Chests, Hydrothermal Crates, and Sulphurous Crates
weapons.why: primary sentry for stationary damage

weapons.effect: When used, it summons a grounded polyp sentry which inaccurately fires gravity-affected balls of coral at nearby enemies. On hit, the coral chunk bursts into 1-4 fragments which deals half as much damage and knockback.

weapons.name: Flesh of Infidelity

items.effect: Allows flight · The wearer can run super fast · Flower grow on the grass you walk on · Fairies can spawn at any time on the surface and spawn far more frequently · Nearby fairies grant +1 HP/s life regen, 4 defense and 10% movement speed · Fairies are immune to damage and will no longer flee

items.name: Terraspark Boots
items.source: Combined through the full boots crafting chain
items.why: Fairy boots offer defensive benefits.
items.effect: Allows flight, super fast running, and extra mobility on ice · 8% increased movement speed · Provides the ability to walk on water, honey & lava · Grants immunity to fire blocks and 7 seconds of immunity to lava · Reduces damage from touching lava

items.name: Frog Leg
items.source: Fished up in any body of water, and craftable by hand.
items.why: Increases the player's jump speed and fall resistance.

items.name: Amalgamated Brain
items.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
items.effect: Taking damage confuses nearby enemies and spawns a dank creeper · The dank creeper flies above you, exploding into several shaderain clouds · Grants or improves the ability to dodge attacks · After dodging, summon damage and crit chance are boosted by 10%

items.name: Frost Flare
items.effect: All attacks and projectiles inflict Frostbite · Being above 50% life grants 10% increased damage · Being below 50% life grants 10 defense and 15% increased max movement speed and acceleration · Grants resistance against cold attacks, Frostburn , Chilled and Frozen

items.name: Giant Tortoise Shell
items.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
items.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · 10% increased damage reduction and 10% reduced dash velocity · Taking a hit restores dash velocity and reduces defense and damage reduction for 3 seconds

items.name: Honey Dew
items.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
items.effect: It multiplies natural life regeneration by 1.5x while equipped.

items.name: Radiant Ooze
items.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
items.effect: While equipped, it grants + 0.5 HP/s to + 2.5 HP/s; the lower the player's health, the stronger the effect. It also makes the player emit yellow light if visibility is enabled.

items.name: Star Veil
items.why: Longer invincibility after a hit, plus retaliating falling stars.

items.name: Abaddon
items.effect: When equipped, all critical strikes inflict the Bane debuff. Bane deals a base of 20 damage per second, and its damage is increased by 3% for each point of critical strike chance the player has.

items.name: Arcane Flower
items.why: 8% reduced mana cost, auto mana potions, and enemies are less likely to target you.

items.name: Sorcerer Emblem
items.source: Dropped by the Wall of Flesh
items.why: Increases magic damage by 15%.

items.name: Moon Stone
items.source: Dropped by Vampires during a Solar Eclipse
items.why: In respect to survivability, the Moon Stone increases the player's defense by 4 and health regeneration by 1 HP/s, from 7:30 PM to 4:30 AM.

items.name: Mana Polarizer
items.effect: Increases maximum mana by 40 · Provides life regeneration and magic damage that scales based on how much mana you have · Lower mana means more life regeneration, but less magic damage · These scale from -2 to +2 HP/s, and 15% to 5% damage · The provided regeneration is halved when under Mana Sickness · Magic projectiles steal enemy life

tools.name: Lunic Eye
tools.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
tools.effect: When used, it fires an orange particle bolt that does not pierce nor pass through tiles and inflicts the Marked for Death debuff. It sharply homes in on enemies within a 15-tile radius, gradually turning itself purple as it moves closer to the target.

tools.name: Rod of Discord
tools.effect: When used, it instantly teleports the player to the location of the cursor and inflicts the Chaos State debuff on the player for 6 seconds. Using the Rod of Discord while this debuff is active causes the player to lose health equal to 1/7 (14.29%) of their maximum health.

items.why: This has increased vertical mobility.
items.effect: Wings are accessories that allow the player to fly temporarily by holding the ↷ Jump button. They also provide immunity to fall damage. After flight time is exhausted, holding ↷ Jump allows the player to glide, slowing descent speed by 66.67%.

items.name: Evasion Scarf
items.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
items.effect: It grants the ability to dash by double-tapping the ◀ Left or ▶ Right keys, with a base distance of 24 blocks.

items.name: Deep Diver
items.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
items.effect: When equipped, it negates the slow movement speed while submerged in water. It also allows the player to double-tap the ◀ Left or ▶ Right keys to perform a short dash with a base distance of 9 blocks, which can be used in rapid succession.

items.name: Fairy Boots
items.why: Fairy boots offer defensive benefits.
items.effect: Allows flight · The wearer can run super fast · Flower grow on the grass you walk on · Fairies can spawn at any time on the surface and spawn far more frequently · Nearby fairies grant +1 HP/s life regen, 4 defense and 10% movement speed · Fairies are immune to damage and will no longer flee

items.name: Terraspark Boots
items.source: Combined through the full boots crafting chain
items.why: Fairy boots offer defensive benefits.
items.effect: Allows flight, super fast running, and extra mobility on ice · 8% increased movement speed · Provides the ability to walk on water, honey & lava · Grants immunity to fire blocks and 7 seconds of immunity to lava · Reduces damage from touching lava

items.name: Frog Leg
items.source: Fished up in any body of water, and craftable by hand.
items.why: Increases the player's jump speed and fall resistance.

items.name: Amalgamated Brain
items.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
items.effect: Taking damage confuses nearby enemies and spawns a dank creeper · The dank creeper flies above you, exploding into several shaderain clouds · Grants or improves the ability to dodge attacks · After dodging, summon damage and crit chance are boosted by 10%

items.name: Frost Flare
items.effect: All attacks and projectiles inflict Frostbite · Being above 50% life grants 10% increased damage · Being below 50% life grants 10 defense and 15% increased max movement speed and acceleration · Grants resistance against cold attacks, Frostburn , Chilled and Frozen

items.name: Giant Tortoise Shell
items.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
items.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · 10% increased damage reduction and 10% reduced dash velocity · Taking a hit restores dash velocity and reduces defense and damage reduction for 3 seconds

items.name: Honey Dew
items.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
items.effect: It multiplies natural life regeneration by 1.5x while equipped.

items.name: Radiant Ooze
items.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
items.effect: While equipped, it grants + 0.5 HP/s to + 2.5 HP/s; the lower the player's health, the stronger the effect. It also makes the player emit yellow light if visibility is enabled.

items.name: Star Veil
items.why: Longer invincibility after a hit, plus retaliating falling stars.

items.name: Abaddon
items.effect: When equipped, all critical strikes inflict the Bane debuff. Bane deals a base of 20 damage per second, and its damage is increased by 3% for each point of critical strike chance the player has.

items.name: Rogue Emblem
items.source: Dropped by the Wall of Flesh
items.effect: When equipped, it increases rogue damage by 15%. It is the rogue-class equivalent of the vanilla class emblems.

items.name: Ruin Medallion
items.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
items.effect: Stealth strikes only expend 75% of your max stealth · 6% increased rogue damage and rogue crit chance

items.name: Electrician's Glove
items.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
items.effect: Stealth strikes summon sparks on enemy hits and heal you for 10 HP · Stealth strikes also have +8 armor penetration and deal 8% more damage

items.name: Mirage Mirror
items.effect: When equipped, the player builds rogue stealth 25% faster while standing still and 12% faster while moving. It also reduces enemy aggro by 200, however it will not reduce aggro while in the Abyss.

items.name: Moon Stone
items.source: Dropped by Vampires during a Solar Eclipse
items.why: In respect to survivability, the Moon Stone increases the player's defense by 4 and health regeneration by 1 HP/s, from 7:30 PM to 4:30 AM.

tools.name: Lunic Eye
tools.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
tools.effect: When used, it fires an orange particle bolt that does not pierce nor pass through tiles and inflicts the Marked for Death debuff. It sharply homes in on enemies within a 15-tile radius, gradually turning itself purple as it moves closer to the target.

tools.name: Rod of Discord
tools.effect: When used, it instantly teleports the player to the location of the cursor and inflicts the Chaos State debuff on the player for 6 seconds. Using the Rod of Discord while this debuff is active causes the player to lose health equal to 1/7 (14.29%) of their maximum health.

weapons.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil

weapons.effect: On use, it swings in a full circle around the player. Hitting an enemy launches them away from the player and rains a barrage of 4 meteors on them that deals 150% base damage.

weapons.name: Caustic Edge
weapons.source: Crafted at an Iron or Lead Anvil
weapons.effect: Fires a bouncing caustic beam that inflicts Acid Venom and slows on hit.
weapons.why: Bouncing acid beam.

weapons.name: Earthen Pike

weapons.why: Stunning clam flail.

weapons.name: Yin-Yo
weapons.source: Crafted at an Iron or Lead Anvil

weapons.why: Light/dark shard yoyo.

weapons.name: Darklight Greatsword
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.why: solid broadsword projectile option
weapons.effect: When swung, it fires a blue or purple blade that starts off slow before accelerating at full speed but will lose velocity as it goes through tiles and fade out before disappearing. The blades pierce twice and function similarly to the Death Sickle 's scythes.

weapons.name: Inferna Cutter
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.why: hits repeatedly, so it suits worms and grouped enemies
weapons.effect: When swung, it emits light particles and releases several sparks similar to those fired by the Butcher's Chainsaw, which deal 50% of the weapon's damage. When performing critical hits, it will also cause a small explosion, dealing 50% of the weapon's damage and can only hit the same enemy.

weapons.name: Majestic Guard
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.why: difficult to use; suits multi-hit targets

weapons.name: Starnight Lance
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.why: viable melee spear option
weapons.effect: When used, it fires a starlight beam that pierces twice and travels a moderate distance before dissipating. The spear and beams inflict the Frostbite debuff.

items.name: Butterfly Wings

items.why: Allows the player to fly briefly and glide (and negates fall damage).

items.name: Ornate Shield

items.name: Fairy Boots
items.why: Fairy boots offer defensive benefits.
items.effect: Allows flight · The wearer can run super fast · Flower grow on the grass you walk on · Fairies can spawn at any time on the surface and spawn far more frequently · Nearby fairies grant +1 HP/s life regen, 4 defense and 10% movement speed · Fairies are immune to damage and will no longer flee

items.name: Terraspark Boots

items.name: Frog Leg
items.source: Fished up in any body of water, and craftable by hand.
items.why: Increases the player's jump speed and fall resistance.

items.name: Amalgamated Brain
items.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
items.effect: Taking damage confuses nearby enemies and spawns a dank creeper · The dank creeper flies above you, exploding into several shaderain clouds · Grants or improves the ability to dodge attacks · After dodging, summon damage and crit chance are boosted by 10%

items.name: Frost Flare
items.effect: All attacks and projectiles inflict Frostbite · Being above 50% life grants 10% increased damage · Being below 50% life grants 10 defense and 15% increased max movement speed and acceleration · Grants resistance against cold attacks, Frostburn , Chilled and Frozen

items.name: Giant Tortoise Shell
items.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
items.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · 10% increased damage reduction and 10% reduced dash velocity · Taking a hit restores dash velocity and reduces defense and damage reduction for 3 seconds

items.name: Honey Dew
items.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
items.effect: It multiplies natural life regeneration by 1.5x while equipped.

items.name: Radiant Ooze
items.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
items.effect: While equipped, it grants + 0.5 HP/s to + 2.5 HP/s; the lower the player's health, the stronger the effect. It also makes the player emit yellow light if visibility is enabled.

items.name: Star Veil
items.why: Longer invincibility after a hit, plus retaliating falling stars.

items.name: Abaddon
items.effect: When equipped, all critical strikes inflict the Bane debuff. Bane deals a base of 20 damage per second, and its damage is increased by 3% for each point of critical strike chance the player has.

items.name: Magic Quiver
items.why: Increases arrow damage by 10% and arrow speed by 20%, and gives a 20% chance not to consume arrows.

items.name: Ranger Emblem
items.source: Dropped by the Wall of Flesh
items.why: 15% ranged damage.

items.name: Moon Stone
items.source: Dropped by Vampires during a Solar Eclipse
items.why: In respect to survivability, the Moon Stone increases the player's defense by 4 and health regeneration by 1 HP/s, from 7:30 PM to 4:30 AM.

tools.name: Lunic Eye
tools.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
tools.effect: When used, it fires an orange particle bolt that does not pierce nor pass through tiles and inflicts the Marked for Death debuff. It sharply homes in on enemies within a 15-tile radius, gradually turning itself purple as it moves closer to the target.

tools.name: Rod of Discord
tools.effect: When used, it instantly teleports the player to the location of the cursor and inflicts the Chaos State debuff on the player for 6 seconds. Using the Rod of Discord while this debuff is active causes the player to lose health equal to 1/7 (14.29%) of their maximum health.

weapons.name: Unholy Trident

weapons.why: Fires a spectral trident that passes through blocks.

weapons.name: SHPC
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.why: solid alternative magic weapon
weapons.effect: Consumes Souls as ammo · Ejects orbs of unstable, concentrated soulpower that linger and explode · Orbs emit seeking souls and lingering pickup souls after collapse · Orbs have varying effects depending on Soul type used · [SOUL DESCRIPTION] · Press ⚷ Open / Activate to use the machine as a vacuum, pulling in lingering souls · Once released, a torrent of soul lasers is discharged scaling with the number of souls pulled in · Shift- ⚷ Open / Activate this item in your inventory to eject the currently loaded Soul · Tales of legends past radiate around you... · Hold Shift to listen closer 'Though soul-powered machines were a near failure, potential remained in souls as a form of fuel. · To avoid my last experiments' main flaw, the Soul-Harnessing Plasma Cannon was designed to expel souls as projectiles before they exert control over the weapon. · Each soul type appears to react differently to the base plasma. Yet, lacking volunteers, obtaining potential ammunition is currently too difficult to undergo further testing. · A shame, for a weapon that could have practically unlimited ammunition in the battlefield. Perhaps some day, its potential can be truly tested.'

items.name: Master Ninja Gear

items.effect: It allows the player to cling to and slide down vertical walls, quickly dash short distances by double-tapping either the ◀ Left or ▶ Right key, and offers a 1/10 (10%) chance to automatically dodge enemy attacks. There is a one-second cooldown period between dashes.

tools.name: Lunic Eye
tools.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
tools.effect: When used, it fires an orange particle bolt that does not pierce nor pass through tiles and inflicts the Marked for Death debuff. It sharply homes in on enemies within a 15-tile radius, gradually turning itself purple as it moves closer to the target.

tools.name: Rod of Discord
tools.effect: When used, it instantly teleports the player to the location of the cursor and inflicts the Chaos State debuff on the player for 6 seconds. Using the Rod of Discord while this debuff is active causes the player to lose health equal to 1/7 (14.29%) of their maximum health.

weapons.name: Alula Australis
weapons.source: Dropped by Astrum Aureus
weapons.why: first-listed primary magic weapon for this tier
weapons.effect: When used, it fires an aurora beam which travels in a cosine pattern. As the beam travels, homing astral stars trail with the beam and rain down from the sky.

weapons.name: Primordial Earth
weapons.source: Crafted at a Bookcase
weapons.why: listed magic weapon option
weapons.effect: It is a direct upgrade to the Death Valley Duster, firing 2 dust blows that pass through tiles and converge into an explosion of dust that inflicts the Armor Crunch debuff. Using it at full mana and with no Mana Sickness gives the player, and any player that touches the dust particles, the Sand's Wind buff which increases defense by 4, damage by 12%, and mana regeneration.

weapons.name: Rainbow Gun
weapons.source: Found in Hallowed Chest in the Dungeon (opened with a Hallowed Key)
weapons.why: Launches a lasting rainbow that damages enemies along its arc.

weapons.name: SHPC
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.why: used with Souls of Sight ammo
weapons.effect: Consumes Souls as ammo · Ejects orbs of unstable, concentrated soulpower that linger and explode · Orbs emit seeking souls and lingering pickup souls after collapse · Orbs have varying effects depending on Soul type used · [SOUL DESCRIPTION] · Press ⚷ Open / Activate to use the machine as a vacuum, pulling in lingering souls · Once released, a torrent of soul lasers is discharged scaling with the number of souls pulled in · Shift- ⚷ Open / Activate this item in your inventory to eject the currently loaded Soul · Tales of legends past radiate around you... · Hold Shift to listen closer 'Though soul-powered machines were a near failure, potential remained in souls as a form of fuel. · To avoid my last experiments' main flaw, the Soul-Harnessing Plasma Cannon was designed to expel souls as projectiles before they exert control over the weapon. · Each soul type appears to react differently to the base plasma. Yet, lacking volunteers, obtaining potential ammunition is currently too difficult to undergo further testing. · A shame, for a weapon that could have practically unlimited ammunition in the battlefield. Perhaps some day, its potential can be truly tested.'

weapons.name: Undine's Retribution
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.why: listed magic weapon option
weapons.effect: When used, it spawns 3 aqua spears from below the screen that quickly home in on nearby enemies. The spears can pass through tiles but cannot pierce.

weapons.name: Wasp Gun
weapons.source: Dropped by Plantera
weapons.why: Fires several homing wasp projectiles per shot.

weapons.why: Random sea-creature swarm.

weapons.source: Dropped by Leviathan and Anahita
weapons.effect: Casts aquatic spears that split as they travel.
weapons.why: Splitting water spears.

weapons.name: Tears of Heaven
weapons.source: Crafted at a Bookcase
weapons.effect: Casts slow homing balls of heavenly light that inflict Hellfire and Frostbite.
weapons.why: Homing light with dual debuffs.

weapons.source: Dropped by Pumpking (Pumpkin Moon)

weapons.why: Pumpking drop whose swings can hit multiple times with a strong summon tag.

weapons.name: Raven Staff

weapons.why: Summons a raven that flies and charges through enemies.
weapons.effect: Summons a raven that flies and charges through enemies.

weapons.name: Plantation Staff
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: When used, it summons a miniature Plantera minion that cycles between 3 attacks. It starts out by firing thorn balls that stick to enemies and hit twice, then rapidly fires seeds at enemies.

weapons.name: Pygmy Staff
weapons.source: Dropped by Plantera
weapons.why: Summons a Pygmy that fires spears which inflict the Acid Venom debuff.
weapons.effect: Summons a Pygmy that fires spears which inflict the Acid Venom debuff.

weapons.name: Morning Star
weapons.source: Dropped by Armored Bones enemies in the post-Plantera Hardmode Dungeon
weapons.why: A flail that gains critical strike chance with combos.

weapons.name: Gastric Belcher Staff
weapons.source: Dropped by Leviathan and Anahita
weapons.why: Summons aquatic aberrations that fire vomit at nearby enemies, with ev
weapons.effect: Summons aquatic aberrations that fire vomit at nearby enemies, with every third attack firing bubbles.

weapons.name: Cryogenic Staff
weapons.source: Purchased from Archmage for 35 after defeating all the Mechanical Bosses
weapons.why: primary sentry recommendation
weapons.effect: When summoned, the ice sentry fires an ice ball that inflicts the Frostbite debuff, as well as their rate increasing the longer an enemy is targeted. After targeting an enemy for three seconds, the sentry goes into a frenzied state, spinning around rapidly and firing ice balls with significantly increased fire rate as well as icicles in all directions.

weapons.name: Dreadmine Staff
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.why: listed alternative sentry
weapons.effect: It summons a stationary mine base that summons mines on nearby tiles which home in on enemies. When an enemy comes in contact with a mine, it will blow up.

weapons.name: Desert Tiger Staff
weapons.source: Found in the Dungeon's Desert Chest, unlocked with a Desert Key after Plantera
weapons.why: Summons a single Desert Tiger minion that grows stronger with additional summons.

weapons.name: Sand Sharknado Staff
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.why: solid alternative minion
weapons.effect: When used, it summons a sandnado to attack nearby enemies by firing miniature high velocity Sand Sharks at them.

weapons.name: Viral Sprout
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: When used, it summons a flower-shaped spirit that attacks nearby enemies by firing gravity-affected needles. When moving or attacking, the spirits will move in a group with individual circular motions and launch an even spread of three needles upwards.

weapons.name: Hive Pod
weapons.source: Dropped by Astraglomerates after Astrum Aureus has been defeated
weapons.why: alternative sentry
weapons.effect: The Astral Hive will spawn Hivelings if there are any enemies nearby, which will home onto the closest enemy to them, even through walls.

weapons.name: Staff of the Frost Hydra
weapons.source: Found in the Dungeon's Ice Chest, opened with a Frozen Key (post-Plantera)
weapons.why: Post-Plantera sentry summoning a Frost Hydra that fires piercing frost blasts.

weapons.name: Borealis Bomber
weapons.source: Dropped by Astrum Aureus
weapons.effect: When used, it summons an Aureus Bomber that does not take up minion slots. It attacks by ramming into enemies within a range of 43 tiles and exploding upon impact, inflicting the Astral Infection debuff.

armor.effect: +58% summon damage · +4 minion slots · +20% movement speed · A visual glowing effect around the player

items.name: Spectre Wings
items.source: Crafted at Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
items.why: Allows the player to fly briefly and glide (and negates fall damage).
items.effect: Wings are accessories that allow the player to fly temporarily by holding the ↷ Jump button. They also provide immunity to fall damage. After flight time is exhausted, holding ↷ Jump allows the player to glide, slowing descent speed by 66.67%.

items.name: Angel Treads
items.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
items.why: Fairy boots offer defensive benefits.
items.effect: Allows flight, super fast running, and extra mobility on ice · 12% increased movement speed and 10% increased flight time · Provides the ability to walk on water, honey & lava · Grants immunity to fire blocks and 7 seconds of immunity to lava · Reduces damage from touching lava · 'Extreme speed!'

items.name: Fairy Boots
items.why: Fairy boots offer defensive benefits.
items.effect: Allows flight · The wearer can run super fast · Flower grow on the grass you walk on · Fairies can spawn at any time on the surface and spawn far more frequently · Nearby fairies grant +1 HP/s life regen, 4 defense and 10% movement speed · Fairies are immune to damage and will no longer flee

items.name: Asgard's Valor
items.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
items.why: Master Ninja Gear has a faster dash and a consistent dodge on a cooldown.
items.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · Allows the ability to ram dash · This dash can ram through enemies without taking damage

items.name: Master Ninja Gear
items.why: In respect to mobility, the Master Ninja Gear enables the player to dash. Compared to the Shield of Cthulhu, the Master Ninja Gear's dash is twice as long and does not have any effect if the player collides with an enemy.
items.effect: It allows the player to cling to and slide down vertical walls, quickly dash short distances by double-tapping either the ◀ Left or ▶ Right key, and offers a 1/10 (10%) chance to automatically dodge enemy attacks. There is a one-second cooldown period between dashes.

items.name: Amalgamated Brain
items.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
items.effect: Taking damage confuses nearby enemies and spawns a dank creeper · The dank creeper flies above you, exploding into several shaderain clouds · Grants or improves the ability to dodge attacks · After dodging, summon damage and crit chance are boosted by 10%

items.name: Hallowed Rune
items.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
items.effect: Minion attacks provide various buffs · Does not stack with downgrades · Hold Shift for more Hallowed Power grants 10% increased summon damage and rains stars on enemies · Hallowed Defense grants 5 defense · Hallowed Regen grants +1 HP/s life regen

items.name: Bloom Stone
items.effect: Healing Potions are 50% more effective, but provide their healing over time · Grappling hooks retract and pull the player 30 mph faster, and grow a flower at hookpoints · Touching a flower makes it burst into pollen which gives a temporary boost to potion healing over time · Potion healing slows drastically when at full health · 'One of the ancient relics'

items.name: Frozen Shield
items.why: Essentially an upgraded version of the Frozen Turtle Shell which provides 6 defense, reduces all damage taken by the player by 25% if the player is below 50% max HP, and grants immunity to knockback.

items.name: Hero Shield
items.why: Provides 10 defense, increases the player's aggro by 400, and provides immunity to knockback.

items.name: Living Dew
items.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
items.effect: It multiplies natural life regeneration by 1.5x and makes it generate 100% faster while equipped.

items.name: Star Veil
items.why: Longer invincibility after a hit, plus retaliating falling stars.

items.name: Jelly-Charged Battery
items.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
items.effect: Increases your max number of minions by 1, and summon damage by 7% · Minion attacks create charged orbs

items.name: Sand Shark Tooth Necklace
items.effect: When equipped, it increases armor penetration by 10 and increases all damage by 10%.
