items.effect: While equipped, it grants 1 minion slot and causes all minion attacks to spawn a small astral explosion on enemy hits, dealing 40 summon damage and inflicting the Astral Infection debuff for 3 seconds. The effect has a 1 second cooldown.

items.name: The First Shadowflame
items.effect: Increases your max number of minions by 1 · Minion attacks inflict Shadowflame , and grants immunity to Shadowflame

items.name: Moon Stone
items.source: Dropped by Vampires during a Solar Eclipse
items.why: In respect to survivability, the Moon Stone increases the player's defense by 4 and health regeneration by 1 HP/s, from 7:30 PM to 4:30 AM.

tools.name: Lunic Eye
tools.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
tools.effect: When used, it fires an orange particle bolt that does not pierce nor pass through tiles and inflicts the Marked for Death debuff. It sharply homes in on enemies within a 15-tile radius, gradually turning itself purple as it moves closer to the target.

tools.name: Rod of Discord
tools.effect: When used, it instantly teleports the player to the location of the cursor and inflicts the Chaos State debuff on the player for 6 seconds. Using the Rod of Discord while this debuff is active causes the player to lose health equal to 1/7 (14.29%) of their maximum health.

weapons.name: Defective Sphere
weapons.source: Dropped by Deadly Spheres
weapons.why: primary spam rogue weapon at this tier
weapons.effect: They can be thrown up to five times. Spheres thrown can become one of four variants, listed below.

weapons.name: Fantasy Talisman
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.why: strong spam alternative
weapons.effect: When used, it throws a talisman card that sticks onto enemies, periodically releasing homing souls that deal 50% of the weapon's base damage. Up to 3 talismans can stick to an enemy at a time.

weapons.name: Leviathan Teeth
weapons.source: Dropped by Leviathan and Anahita
weapons.why: additional spam option; solid stealth alternative
weapons.effect: When used, they rapidly throw an inaccurate tight spread of 2 gravity-affected teeth that inflict the Heavy Bleeding debuff on contact with enemies and stick to them. After sticking for 2 seconds, teeth will launch out the other side of the enemy, dealing an additional burst of damage.

weapons.name: Phantasmal Ruin
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.why: additional spam option; additional stealth option
weapons.effect: When used, it throws a fast ghost lance that goes through tiles and explodes into 4 homing spirits on enemy hits while disappearing on direct hit.

weapons.name: Samsara Slicer
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.why: additional spam option; additional stealth option
weapons.effect: When used, it throws a disk that quickly returns to the player after hitting an enemy or after traveling for a short distance. The disk can pass through blocks and pierce infinitely, and has a chance to fire 6 smaller disks outwards from it when an enemy is nearby, which linger for a short time before dissipating.

weapons.name: Stellar Knife
weapons.source: Dropped by Aries after Astrum Aureus is defeated
weapons.why: additional spam option; additional stealth option
weapons.effect: When thrown, it moves and rapidly spins in the direction it was initially thrown, slowly decelerating and losing spin speed over time. Once the knife fully decelerates, it then remains still until an enemy is within its detection range for it to home in.

weapons.name: Duststorm in a Bottle
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.why: primary stealth-strike weapon
weapons.effect: When used, it throws a bottle that shatters into a dust cloud after a delay, or when hitting an enemy. Holding down left-click charges the weapon, generating stealth but causing it to shatter sooner.

armor.name: Umbraphile armor
armor.source: Crafted at Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
armor.effect: +110 maximum stealth · Rogue weapons have a chance to create explosions on hit · Stealth strikes always create an explosion
armor.desc: Umbraphile armor is a Hardmode rogue armor set. If the full set is visible (whether equipped or in social slots), the player emits a motion blur afterimage while they are moving.

items.effect: It allows the player to cling to and slide down vertical walls, quickly dash short distances by double-tapping either the ◀ Left or ▶ Right key, and offers a 1/10 (10%) chance to automatically dodge enemy attacks. There is a one-second cooldown period between dashes.

items.name: Amalgamated Brain
items.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
items.effect: Taking damage confuses nearby enemies and spawns a dank creeper · The dank creeper flies above you, exploding into several shaderain clouds · Grants or improves the ability to dodge attacks · After dodging, summon damage and crit chance are boosted by 10%

items.name: Bloom Stone
items.effect: Healing Potions are 50% more effective, but provide their healing over time · Grappling hooks retract and pull the player 30 mph faster, and grow a flower at hookpoints · Touching a flower makes it burst into pollen which gives a temporary boost to potion healing over time · Potion healing slows drastically when at full health · 'One of the ancient relics'

items.name: Frozen Shield
items.why: Essentially an upgraded version of the Frozen Turtle Shell which provides 6 defense, reduces all damage taken by the player by 25% if the player is below 50% max HP, and grants immunity to knockback.

items.name: Hero Shield
items.why: Provides 10 defense, increases the player's aggro by 400, and provides immunity to knockback.

items.name: Living Dew
items.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
items.effect: It multiplies natural life regeneration by 1.5x and makes it generate 100% faster while equipped.

items.name: Star Veil
items.why: Longer invincibility after a hit, plus retaliating falling stars.

items.name: Ruin Medallion
items.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
items.effect: Stealth strikes only expend 75% of your max stealth · 6% increased rogue damage and rogue crit chance

items.name: Sand Shark Tooth Necklace
items.effect: When equipped, it increases armor penetration by 10 and increases all damage by 10%.

items.name: Abyssal Mirror
items.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
items.effect: Enemies are less likely to target you, even in the abyss · Generate stealth 25% faster when standing still and 12% faster while moving · Grants or improves the ability to dodge attacks · Dodging an attack restores stealth and releases a cloud that damages and stuns nearby enemies · 'Light does not reach the depths of the ocean'

items.name: Electrician's Glove
items.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
items.effect: Stealth strikes summon sparks on enemy hits and heal you for 10 HP · Stealth strikes also have +8 armor penetration and deal 8% more damage

items.name: Glove of Precision
items.source: Purchased from the Bandit for 48 gold after Plantera has been defeated
items.effect: Decreases rogue attack speed by 15% · Increases rogue damage and critical strike chance by 10%, and velocity by 15%

items.name: Vampiric Talisman
items.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
items.effect: When equipped, it causes rogue critical hits to steal 1.5% of their damage (rounded down) in health. Additionally, it increases stealth strike damage by 8% and causes all stealth strikes to inflict Armor Crunch for 2.5 seconds and Heavy Bleeding for 5 seconds.

items.name: Moon Stone
items.source: Dropped by Vampires during a Solar Eclipse
items.why: In respect to survivability, the Moon Stone increases the player's defense by 4 and health regeneration by 1 HP/s, from 7:30 PM to 4:30 AM.

tools.name: Lunic Eye
tools.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
tools.effect: When used, it fires an orange particle bolt that does not pierce nor pass through tiles and inflicts the Marked for Death debuff. It sharply homes in on enemies within a 15-tile radius, gradually turning itself purple as it moves closer to the target.

tools.name: Rod of Discord
tools.effect: When used, it instantly teleports the player to the location of the cursor and inflicts the Chaos State debuff on the player for 6 seconds. Using the Rod of Discord while this debuff is active causes the player to lose health equal to 1/7 (14.29%) of their maximum health.

weapons.name: Briny Baron
weapons.source: Dropped by Duke Fishron
weapons.why: versatile sword with strong projectile damage
weapons.effect: When used with its primary fire (left-click), it will swing, and deal damage in a normal manner. Striking an enemy with the sword spawns a shortly lingering typhoon that deals 50% of the weapon's damage in rapid successions and only one typhoon can exist at a time.

weapons.name: Exalted Oathblade
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.why: solid melee sword alternative
weapons.effect: When used with its primary function (left-click), it throws a sword that sticks into enemies and reduces their speed, with a max of 4 being able to be stuck into a single enemy. If another is stuck, the oldest one will be launched out.

weapons.name: Flying Dragon
weapons.source: Dropped by Betsy (Old One's Army Tier 3)
weapons.why: Fires a red crescent-shaped projectile on each swing.

weapons.name: Galvanizing Glaive
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.why: reliable spear-type melee option
weapons.effect: When used, the player swings a spear around similarly to the Ghastly Glaive, and releases five gauss energy projectiles, each dealing 40% of the weapon's damage. If the target is struck by the spear itself, there is a 1/12 chance per hit for an energy flux to spawn on the enemy, which continuously deals the weapon's damage.

weapons.name: Lucrecia
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.why: strong melee weapon alternative
weapons.effect: When used, it swings back and forth in front of the player, firing a darklight shard that pierces infinitely but cannot pass through tiles with each swing. Hitting with the sword itself builds up Darklight Energy, a resource that dissipates slowly over time, but briefly stops anytime it is gained.

weapons.name: Omniblade
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.why: listed first as the primary melee weapon with high true-melee DPS
weapons.effect: When used, it uses a custom overhead swing animation that does not direct toward the cursor.

weapons.name: Fallen Paladin's Hammer
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.why: returning hammer with good crowd damage
weapons.effect: When used, it throws a fast gravity-affected hammer that passes through tiles. Upon hitting an enemy, it slows down and starts returning to the player.

weapons.name: Sky Dragon’s Fury
weapons.source: Dropped by Betsy during Tier 3 of the Old One’s Army
weapons.why: Nunchaku-style flail that spins and fires a homing burst.

weapons.name: Flairon
weapons.source: Dropped by Duke Fishron
weapons.why: A Hardmode flail.

weapons.name: Fault Line
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: Explodes on enemy hits and inflicts Hellfire.
weapons.why: Exploding Hellfire yoyo.

weapons.name: Pandemic
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: Grows in size, power, and airtime with each Plague-infected enemy struck.
weapons.why: Plague-scaling yoyo.

items.why: This should be used with Angel Treads
items.effect: Wings are accessories that allow the player to fly temporarily by holding the ↷ Jump button. They also provide immunity to fall damage. After flight time is exhausted, holding ↷ Jump allows the player to glide, slowing descent speed by 66.67%.

items.name: Empress Wings
items.source: Dropped by the Empress of Light
items.why: Flight and slow fall, with an upward boost.

items.name: Fishron Wings
items.why: Flight, and faster movement in rain and water.

items.name: Angel Treads
items.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
items.why: Fairy boots offer defensive benefits.
items.effect: Allows flight, super fast running, and extra mobility on ice · 12% increased movement speed and 10% increased flight time · Provides the ability to walk on water, honey & lava · Grants immunity to fire blocks and 7 seconds of immunity to lava · Reduces damage from touching lava · 'Extreme speed!'

items.name: Fairy Boots
items.why: Fairy boots offer defensive benefits.
items.effect: Allows flight · The wearer can run super fast · Flower grow on the grass you walk on · Fairies can spawn at any time on the surface and spawn far more frequently · Nearby fairies grant +1 HP/s life regen, 4 defense and 10% movement speed · Fairies are immune to damage and will no longer flee

items.name: Asgard's Valor
items.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil

items.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · Allows the ability to ram dash · This dash can ram through enemies without taking damage

items.name: Master Ninja Gear
items.why: In respect to mobility, the Master Ninja Gear enables the player to dash. Compared to the Shield of Cthulhu, the Master Ninja Gear's dash is twice as long and does not have any effect if the player collides with an enemy.
items.effect: It allows the player to cling to and slide down vertical walls, quickly dash short distances by double-tapping either the ◀ Left or ▶ Right key, and offers a 1/10 (10%) chance to automatically dodge enemy attacks. There is a one-second cooldown period between dashes.

items.name: Shield of the High Ruler
items.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
items.why: Master Ninja Gear has a faster dash and a consistent dodge on a cooldown.
items.effect: +10 max life · Grants immunity to knockback and most debuffs · Grants an improved Shield of Cthulhu dash · Bonking an enemy halves dash cooldown time · Facing a projectile when it hits you reduces its damage by 15% · 'For the fate of the kingdom'

items.name: Interstellar Stompers
items.effect: 6% increased movement speed, 20% increased jump speed, and negates fall damage · Hold ▼ Down to increase your maximum fall speed · Pressing Interstellar Stompers Hotkey while midair charges up a superspeed slam over 0.33 seconds · While falling, you ram through enemies and don't take contact damage · Once you hit the ground, you create an explosion at your feet · The explosion scales in both damage and size the longer you slam for · Temporary 40% increased jump speed after slamming into the ground

items.name: Soaring Insignia
items.source: Empress of Light Treasure Bag (Expert or Master)
items.why: Improved jump, run, and flight mobility.
items.effect: +10% jump speed · +25% run acceleration · +33% flight time

items.name: Celestial Shell
items.why: All-round stats, plus werewolf at night and merfolk in water.

items.name: Blood Pact
items.why: This should be used with Bloom Stone

items.name: Bloom Stone
items.why: This should be used with Blood Pact

items.name: Frozen Shield
items.why: Essentially an upgraded version of the Frozen Turtle Shell which provides 6 defense, reduces all damage taken by the player by 25% if the player is below 50% max HP, and grants immunity to knockback.

items.name: Living Dew
items.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
items.effect: It multiplies natural life regeneration by 1.5x and makes it generate 100% faster while equipped.

items.name: Star Veil
items.why: Longer invincibility after a hit, plus retaliating falling stars.

items.name: Alchemical Decanter
items.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
items.effect: All attacks inflict the Plague and reduces damage taken from the Plague by 50% · Projectiles spawn plague seekers on enemy hits · Releases plague bees and douses you in Honey when damaged

items.name: Apollyon
items.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
items.effect: When equipped, all critical strikes inflict the Bane debuff. Additionally, critical strikes spread all debuffs inflicted on the hit enemy that are weaker than Bane to up to 10 enemies within an 87.5-tile range, and critical strikes deal 3% increased damage for every debuff inflicted on the enemy.

items.name: Deadshot Brooch
items.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
items.effect: 12% increased ranged damage, 7% increased ranged critical strike chance and 20% reduced ammo usage · Pressing Ammo Cycle Hotkey will automatically swap the order of ammos in your ammo slots · The ammo type swapped depends on the ammo of the weapon you are holding

items.name: Sand Shark Tooth Necklace
items.effect: When equipped, it increases armor penetration by 10 and increases all damage by 10%.

items.name: Sniper Scope
items.why: 10% ranged damage and crit, and zooms out when you right-click with a gun.
items.effect: Increases view range for guns (Right click to zoom out) · 10% increased ranged damage and critical strike chance

items.name: Celestial Shell
items.why: All-round stats, plus werewolf at night and merfolk in water.

weapons.why: Fires a homing prismatic bolt that rains down piercing feathers.

weapons.why: high-DPS mine sentry
weapons.effect: It summons a stationary mine base that summons mines on nearby tiles which home in on enemies. When an enemy comes in contact with a mine, it will blow up.

weapons.name: Spikecrag Staff
weapons.source: Dropped by the Ravager
weapons.why: area-denial sentry
weapons.effect: When used, it summons a Spikecrag sentry that attacks enemies by firing an intense upward spray of gravity-affected spikes; a total of 1 to 2 spikes are fired every 1/6th of a second.

weapons.name: Dark Harvest

armor.why: melee set with brimstone offensive bonuses
armor.effect: Immunity to the On Fire! debuff and lava · While below 50% health, grants a modified Inferno that deals 50 damage and inflicts Brimstone Flames on nearby enemies, and causes an explosion on hit dealing 115 / 230 / 345 damage and inflicting Hellfire
armor.desc: Hydrothermic armor is a Hardmode armor set.
armor.headpieceBonus: +48% summon damage · +2 minion slots · +10% movement speed · Summons a Hydrothermic Vent minion that floats above you, firing for 190 damage and inflicting Hellfire

armor.name: Plaguebringer armor

armor.effect: +60% summon damage · +3 minion slots · +15% movement speed · Immunity to the Plague debuff · Friendly bees and wasps inflict Plague · Summons a small Plaguebringer minion that fires homing bees and plague bees dealing 25 summon damage · Plague ram dash (double-tap Left or Right, base 23 blocks) dealing 50 summon damage and granting 12 immunity frames per enemy hit · Grows tall flowers on grass while walking and can spawn random dye plants or Strange Plants on dirt

tools.name: Lunic Eye
tools.source: Crafted at an Iron Anvil or Lead Anvil
tools.effect: When used, it fires an orange particle bolt that does not pierce nor pass through tiles and inflicts the Marked for Death debuff. It sharply homes in on enemies within a 15-tile radius, gradually turning itself purple as it moves closer to the target.

tools.name: Rod of Discord
tools.effect: When used, it instantly teleports the player to the location of the cursor and inflicts the Chaos State debuff on the player for 6 seconds. Using the Rod of Discord while this debuff is active causes the player to lose health equal to 1/7 (14.29%) of their maximum health.

weapons.name: Corpus Avertor
weapons.source: Dropped by the Ravager
weapons.why: top spam-type rogue weapon, listed first with lifesteal; primary stealth-strike option, listed first
weapons.effect: When used, it throws a black knife that spawns smaller homing red knives as it travels. The red knives pass through tiles, deal 40% of the weapon's damage, and heal the player for 5% of their damage dealt. 10% of the player's missing health is added to the weapon's base damage.

weapons.name: Cranium Smasher
weapons.source: Dropped by the Ravager
weapons.why: solid spam alternative
weapons.effect: When used, it alternates between throwing rolling disks and explosive disks. Rolling disks travels a moderate distance before being affected by gravity, and will roll on the ground and pierce up to 4 times before dissipating on the fifth.

weapons.name: Plaguenade
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.why: AoE plague spam option; stealth AoE option
weapons.effect: It is an explosive projectile that release 20 plague-infected bees upon explosion. Both the explosion and the bees inflict the Plague debuff on contact.

weapons.name: Stellar Knife
weapons.source: Dropped by Aries after Astrum Aureus is defeated
weapons.why: rapid-throw spam option
weapons.effect: When thrown, it moves and rapidly spins in the direction it was initially thrown, slowly decelerating and losing spin speed over time. Once the knife fully decelerates, it then remains still until an enemy is within its detection range for it to home in.

weapons.name: The Syringe
weapons.source: Dropped by The Plaguebringer Goliath
weapons.why: spam alternative
weapons.effect: It auto-fires a high velocity syringe that increases damage as it travels and inflicts the Plague debuff. On contact with an enemy or block, it will shatter into glass and plague cinders.

weapons.name: Duke's Decapitator
weapons.source: Dropped by Duke Fishron
weapons.why: high stealth-strike damage
weapons.effect: When used, it throws a fast-spinning axe that slowly decelerates to a stop and breaks shortly after. It will stick onto an enemy upon contact, dealing damage.

weapons.name: Leviathan Teeth
weapons.source: Dropped by Leviathan and Anahita
weapons.why: stealth alternative
weapons.effect: When used, they rapidly throw an inaccurate tight spread of 2 gravity-affected teeth that inflict the Heavy Bleeding debuff on contact with enemies and stick to them. After sticking for 2 seconds, teeth will launch out the other side of the enemy, dealing an additional burst of damage.

weapons.name: System Bane
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.why: stealth alternative
weapons.effect: When used, the player throws a gravity-affected electric machine that continuously deals damage to targets that come into contact with it. Occasionally if there's a target nearby, the device releases lightning to triple-strike it.

items.effect: It allows the player to cling to and slide down vertical walls, quickly dash short distances by double-tapping either the ◀ Left or ▶ Right key, and offers a 1/10 (10%) chance to automatically dodge enemy attacks. There is a one-second cooldown period between dashes.

items.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
items.why: Master Ninja Gear has a faster dash and a consistent dodge on a cooldown.
items.effect: +10 max life · Grants immunity to knockback and most debuffs · Grants an improved Shield of Cthulhu dash · Bonking an enemy halves dash cooldown time · Facing a projectile when it hits you reduces its damage by 15% · 'For the fate of the kingdom'

items.name: Interstellar Stompers

items.name: Soaring Insignia

items.name: Celestial Shell

items.name: Blood Pact

items.name: Bloom Stone

weapons.name: Grand Guardian

weapons.name: Lucrecia
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil

weapons.name: Storm Ruler
weapons.source: Crafted at an Ancient Manipulator
weapons.why: solid melee option

items.name: Betsy's Wings
items.why: This should be used with Angel Treads
items.effect: Wings are accessories that allow the player to fly temporarily by holding the ↷ Jump button. They also provide immunity to fall damage. After flight time is exhausted, holding ↷ Jump allows the player to glide, slowing descent speed by 66.67%.

items.name: Empress Wings
items.source: Dropped by the Empress of Light
items.why: Flight and slow fall, with an upward boost.

items.name: Fishron Wings
items.why: Flight, and faster movement in rain and water.

items.name: Angel Treads
items.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
items.effect: Allows flight, super fast running, and extra mobility on ice · 12% increased movement speed and 10% increased flight time · Provides the ability to walk on water, honey & lava · Grants immunity to fire blocks and 7 seconds of immunity to lava · Reduces damage from touching lava · 'Extreme speed!'

items.name: Asgard's Valor
items.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
items.why: Master Ninja Gear has a faster dash and a consistent dodge on a cooldown.
items.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · Allows the ability to ram dash · This dash can ram through enemies without taking damage

items.name: Master Ninja Gear
items.why: In respect to mobility, the Master Ninja Gear enables the player to dash. Compared to the Shield of Cthulhu, the Master Ninja Gear's dash is twice as long and does not have any effect if the player collides with an enemy.
items.effect: It allows the player to cling to and slide down vertical walls, quickly dash short distances by double-tapping either the ◀ Left or ▶ Right key, and offers a 1/10 (10%) chance to automatically dodge enemy attacks. There is a one-second cooldown period between dashes.

items.name: Shield of the High Ruler
items.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
items.why: Master Ninja Gear has a faster dash and a consistent dodge on a cooldown.
items.effect: +10 max life · Grants immunity to knockback and most debuffs · Grants an improved Shield of Cthulhu dash · Bonking an enemy halves dash cooldown time · Facing a projectile when it hits you reduces its damage by 15% · 'For the fate of the kingdom'

items.name: Interstellar Stompers
items.effect: 6% increased movement speed, 20% increased jump speed, and negates fall damage · Hold ▼ Down to increase your maximum fall speed · Pressing Interstellar Stompers Hotkey while midair charges up a superspeed slam over 0.33 seconds · While falling, you ram through enemies and don't take contact damage · Once you hit the ground, you create an explosion at your feet · The explosion scales in both damage and size the longer you slam for · Temporary 40% increased jump speed after slamming into the ground

items.name: Soaring Insignia
items.source: Empress of Light Treasure Bag (Expert or Master)
items.why: Improved jump, run, and flight mobility.
items.effect: +10% jump speed · +25% run acceleration · +33% flight time

items.name: Celestial Shell
items.why: All-round stats, plus werewolf at night and merfolk in water.

items.name: The Absorber
items.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · 12% increased movement and jump speed · Attackers take immense damage and are afflicted with Absorber Affliction · Using a healing potion will spawn a green aura that lasts for 30 seconds · Walking into the aura removes all debuffs once and grants 2 HP/s regen, 8% damage, and 5% damage reduction · 5% of the damage from enemy attacks is converted into healing

items.name: Ambrosial Ampoule
items.effect: +1 to +3 HP/s life regen based on missing health (Current: +[REGEN] HP/s) · Natural life regen is 50% more potent and returns 100% faster · You emit yellow light if visibility is enabled

items.name: Blood Pact
items.why: This should be used with Bloom Stone
items.effect: When equipped, it increases the player's maximum health by 25%, grants immunity to the Bleeding, Burning Blood & Heavy Bleeding debuffs, and increases the amount of health restored from drinking healing potions by 33%.

items.name: Bloom Stone
items.why: This should be used with Blood Pact
items.effect: Healing Potions are 50% more effective, but provide their healing over time · Grappling hooks retract and pull the player 30 mph faster, and grow a flower at hookpoints · Touching a flower makes it burst into pollen which gives a temporary boost to potion healing over time · Potion healing slows drastically when at full health · 'One of the ancient relics'

items.name: Deific Amulet
items.effect: Releases a burst of homing star-bees, increases movement speed, and drenches you in Honey after taking damage · Increases the length of invincibility, with it increasing even more when at low health · Shift- ⚷ Open / Activate this item in your inventory to toggle Panic Necklace's effect

items.name: Frozen Shield
items.why: Essentially an upgraded version of the Frozen Turtle Shell which provides 6 defense, reduces all damage taken by the player by 25% if the player is below 50% max HP, and grants immunity to knockback.

items.name: Infected Jewel
items.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
items.why: Use on Astrum Deus.
items.effect: +1 HP/s life regen · Reduces damage over time taken by 4 HP/s · Jump-starts regeneration after a damaging debuff ends · 'A beautiful gemstone tarnished by spaceborne rot'

items.name: Apollyon
items.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
items.effect: When equipped, all critical strikes inflict the Bane debuff. Additionally, critical strikes spread all debuffs inflicted on the hit enemy that are weaker than Bane to up to 10 enemies within an 87.5-tile range, and critical strikes deal 3% increased damage for every debuff inflicted on the enemy.

items.name: Deadshot Brooch
items.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
items.effect: 12% increased ranged damage, 7% increased ranged critical strike chance and 20% reduced ammo usage · Pressing Ammo Cycle Hotkey will automatically swap the order of ammos in your ammo slots · The ammo type swapped depends on the ammo of the weapon you are holding

items.name: Sand Shark Tooth Necklace
items.effect: When equipped, it increases armor penetration by 10 and increases all damage by 10%.

items.name: Sniper Scope
items.why: 10% ranged damage and crit, and zooms out when you right-click with a gun.
items.effect: Increases view range for guns (Right click to zoom out) · 10% increased ranged damage and critical strike chance

items.name: Celestial Shell
items.why: All-round stats, plus werewolf at night and merfolk in water.

tools.name: Betsy's Wrath
tools.why: Fires a projectile that reduces enemy defense and creates homing shards.

tools.name: Eye of Magnus
tools.effect: When used, it fires a blue-white energy mass that does not pierce nor pass through tiles, restores 20 mana and heals the player 10% of the damage dealt upon hitting an enemy, and inflicts the Marked for Death debuff. It sharply homes in on enemies within a 20-tile radius, gradually turning its trail pink as it moves closer to the target.

tools.name: Rod of Discord
tools.effect: When used, it instantly teleports the player to the location of the cursor and inflicts the Chaos State debuff on the player for 6 seconds. Using the Rod of Discord while this debuff is active causes the player to lose health equal to 1/7 (14.29%) of their maximum health.

weapons.name: Apoctosis Array
weapons.source: Crafted at an Ancient Manipulator
weapons.effect: When used, it fires spreads of three blasts that have 40 armor penetration and explode on hit, dealing 30% base damage. Holding ⚷ Open / Activate causes the gun to charge up by restoring the player's mana at a rate of 2.5% every two frames.

weapons.name: Nebula Arcanum
weapons.source: Crafted at Ancient Manipulator
weapons.why: Fires slow homing orbs that spawn additional star projectiles.

weapons.name: Nebula Blaze
weapons.source: Crafted at Ancient Manipulator
weapons.why: Fires homing star projectiles with a chance to fire a stronger high-damage shot.

weapons.name: Star Shower
weapons.source: Dropped by Astrum Deus
weapons.effect: When used, it summons a spread of 5 astral stars from the sky that quickly travel to meet at the cursor's location, then continue to fall in that direction. The stars do not pierce enemies but can go through tiles.

weapons.name: The Swarmer
weapons.source: Crafted at an Ancient Manipulator
weapons.effect: When used, it rapidly fires 2 homing bees and wasps per shot that dissipate upon contact with enemies or tiles.

weapons.name: Arch Amaryllis
weapons.source: Crafted at an Ancient Manipulator
weapons.effect: Casts a beaming flower that explodes into homing petals.
weapons.why: Homing petal burst.

weapons.name: Apathanull
weapons.source: Crafted at a Bookcase
weapons.effect: Casts a spread of dark cosmic tentacles that aim at the cursor and lash out three times.
weapons.why: Cursor-aimed cosmic tentacles.

armor.why: melee set with brimstone offensive bonuses

armor.desc: Hydrothermic armor is a Hardmode armor set.
armor.headpieceBonus: +25% magic damage · +19% magic critical strike chance · +100 maximum mana · -15% mana usage · +10% movement speed · Magic hits summon damaging and healing chaos orbs (62.5% of weapon damage, soft-capped at 100; healing orbs restore 10% of damage dealt, -5% per pierce)

armor.name: Spectre armor
armor.source: Crafted at Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
armor.why: Still on-tier at this point. The Mask raises damage, and the Hood variant converts magic damage into healing instead.
armor.desc: Spectre armor is a Hardmode, post- Plantera magic armor set consisting of the Spectre Robe and Spectre Pants, as well as two different headpieces: the Spectre Hood and Spectre Mask, providing offensive and defensive bonuses respectively.

headVariants.effect: Homing damage orbs spawn when you deal magic damage, each dealing 100% of the weapon’s damage and able to crit.

headVariants.name: Hood
headVariants.headpieceBonus: +30 defense · -25% magic damage · +7% magic critical strike chance · +8% movement speed
headVariants.effect: Lifesteal orbs spawn when you deal magic damage, flying to you and restoring 20% of the damage dealt as health.

armor.name: Plaguebringer armor

weapons.name: Plaguenade
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.why: plague-infused grenade with area damage
weapons.effect: It is an explosive projectile that release 20 plague-infected bees upon explosion. Both the explosion and the bees inflict the Plague debuff on contact.

weapons.name: Radiant Star
weapons.source: Crafted at an Ancient Manipulator
weapons.why: rapid star-shard spam damage
weapons.effect: When used, it throws an astral dagger that is not affected by gravity and pierces 3 times. Shortly after it is thrown, it causes a lingering explosion and splits into 3 copies of itself that home in on the closest enemy and deal half of the weapon's damage.

weapons.name: Regulus Riot
weapons.source: Dropped by Astrum Deus
weapons.why: high sustained thrown DPS; powerful stealth-strike option
weapons.effect: When used, it fires a spinning disk towards the cursor's position, traveling a moderate distance before dissipating. If there are enemies nearby, the disk will charge towards the nearest enemy and hit up to 3 times.

weapons.name: Shard of Antumbra
weapons.source: Crafted at an Ancient Manipulator
weapons.why: homing shadow shards, strong single-target; homing shards on stealth strike
weapons.effect: It pierces infinitely and travels significant distances before being affected by gravity. Its damage is decreased by 10% every time it pierces an enemy.

weapons.name: Star of Destruction
weapons.source: Crafted at an Ancient Manipulator
weapons.why: explosive burst damage, and a heavy stealth-strike burst
weapons.effect: On use, it throws a large spread of cosmic bolts which converge into a bomb. The bomb weakly follows the cursor, exploding when it hits an enemy or after 5 seconds.

weapons.name: Duke's Decapitator
weapons.source: Dropped by Duke Fishron
weapons.why: strong homing stealth strike
weapons.effect: When used, it throws a fast-spinning axe that slowly decelerates to a stop and breaks shortly after. It will stick onto an enemy upon contact, dealing damage.

weapons.name: Leviathan Teeth
weapons.source: Dropped by Leviathan and Anahita
weapons.why: thrown teeth with stealth spread
weapons.effect: When used, they rapidly throw an inaccurate tight spread of 2 gravity-affected teeth that inflict the Heavy Bleeding debuff on contact with enemies and stick to them. items.name: Daawnlight Spirit Origin
items.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
items.effect: All ranged weapons can supercrit when critical strike chance is over 100% · Marks enemies and bosses with bullseyes which boost critical strike chance when hit · Extra critical strike chance quickly fades over time · Summons a heroic spirit from another world if visibility is on or in vanity slots · 'A strand of a lost cosmos remains, waiting for its master'

items.name: Dynamo Stem Cells
items.effect: 10% increased ranged damage and movement speed · Ranged weapons fire a powerful mini swarmer every 3 seconds · Reduces damage taken from Dragonfire

items.name: Sand Shark Tooth Necklace

items.name: Sniper Scope

items.name: Warbanner of the Righteous
items.why: This requires being close to the boss to perform well.

tools.name: Eye of Magnus
tools.effect: When used, it fires a blue-white energy mass that does not pierce nor pass through tiles, restores 20 mana and heals the player 10% of the damage dealt upon hitting an enemy, and inflicts the Marked for Death debuff. It sharply homes in on enemies within a 20-tile radius, gradually turning its trail pink as it moves closer to the target.

tools.name: Relic of Deliverance
tools.effect: When used, it mounts the player on the spear, which can be freely turned. Right-clicking dismounts the spear.

tools.name: Rod of Discord
tools.effect: When used, it instantly teleports the player to the location of the cursor and inflicts the Chaos State debuff on the player for 6 seconds. Using the Rod of Discord while this debuff is active causes the player to lose health equal to 1/7 (14.29%) of their maximum health.

ammo.name: Gel
ammo.why: Fuel for flamethrowers like the Shadethrower.

ammo.name: Fallen Star

ammo.effect: Ammunition for the Star Cannon.

weapons.name: Chronomancer's Scythe
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.why: primary recommended magic weapon, high homing DPS
weapons.effect: When used with its primary fire (left-click), the player will swing a scythe towards the cursor rapidly with a tiny range, similarly to the Terragrim. Every 0.083 seconds, a small icicle is inaccurately fired with 120% damage.

weapons.name: Genesis
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.why: strong versatile magic option
weapons.effect: When used, it fires an array of eight lasers that pierce once and decrease in their spread on successive shots. Every 6th shot, the weapon instead fires a powerful splitting beam in a Y-shape, which deals 900% damage and resets the laser spread for the following set of shots.

weapons.name: Nuclear Fury
weapons.source: Crafted at a Bookcase
weapons.why: solid piercing damage
weapons.effect: When used, it fires 8 cosmic typhoons evenly distributed in a circle around the player. The typhoons home in on nearby enemies, pass through tiles and pierce twice.

weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.why: alternative magic weapon

weapons.source: Dropped by Dragonfolly
weapons.why: alternative magic weapon
weapons.effect: When used, it fires three curved waves out from the player, which each vary in their size and speed and pass through tiles. The waves each pierce twice and disappear upon contact with a third.

weapons.name: Cosmic Rainbow
weapons.source: Crafted at an Ancient Manipulator
weapons.effect: Launches a barrage of rainbows and homing sparkles.
weapons.why: Rainbow barrage with homing sparkles.

weapons.name: Effervescence
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: Shoots a wide spread of piercing bubbles that split into homing bubbles.
weapons.why: Piercing bubbles that split and home.

weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: Uses Vis instead of mana: fires piercing needles, and summons a ring of elemental sigils you can activate for varied effects.
weapons.why: Vis-powered needles and elemental sigils.

weapons.why: Cycling elemental flasks.

tools.name: Eye of Magnus

It sharply homes in on enemies within a 20-tile radius, gradually turning its trail pink as it moves closer to the target.

tools.name: Relic of Deliverance
tools.effect: When used, it mounts the player on the spear, which can be freely turned. Right-clicking dismounts the spear.

tools.name: Rod of Discord
tools.effect: When used, it instantly teleports the player to the location of the cursor and inflicts the Chaos State debuff on the player for 6 seconds. Using the Rod of Discord while this debuff is active causes the player to lose health equal to 1/7 (14.29%) of their maximum health.

weapons.name: Celestial Reaper
weapons.source: Purchased from Bandit for 3 after the Moon Lord has been defeated
weapons.effect: When thrown, it will home in on an enemy and will bounce back from the enemy when it hits, allowing it to redirect itself to hit and bounce off of a different enemy, or simply turn around and hit the same enemy again. It will do this up to six times or 10 seconds, slowing down after each hit.

weapons.name: Lunar Kunai
weapons.source: Crafted at an Ancient Manipulator
weapons.effect: When used, it throws 3 gravity-ignoring lunar kunai that slightly home in on enemies and do not pierce. After being in the air for roughly 1 second, the kunai will supercharge, causing them to speed up, changing their color from brown to teal, start emitting dust, and home in far more aggressively.

weapons.name: Profaned Partisan
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: On use, it throws a javelin that splits into holy spears on hit. Holy spears have oscillating velocity and can pierce through enemies.

weapons.name: Rebounding Rainbow
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: When used, it rapidly throws a disk that has a chance of splitting into 8 more disks when near an enemy. The split disks move outward from the point they split from before returning in the player's direction and they last for a shorter duration before dissipating.

weapons.name: Utensil Poker
weapons.source: Dropped by the Moon Lord
weapons.effect: When used, it fires a set of three random utensils.

items.effect: When equipped, it causes rogue critical hits to steal 1.5% of their damage (rounded down) in health. Additionally, it increases stealth strike damage by 8% and causes all stealth strikes to inflict Armor Crunch for 2.5 seconds and Heavy Bleeding for 5 seconds.

tools.name: Eye of Magnus
tools.effect: When used, it fires a blue-white energy mass that does not pierce nor pass through tiles, restores 20 mana and heals the player 10% of the damage dealt upon hitting an enemy, and inflicts the Marked for Death debuff. It sharply homes in on enemies within a 20-tile radius, gradually turning its trail pink as it moves closer to the target.

tools.name: Relic of Deliverance
tools.effect: When used, it mounts the player on the spear, which can be freely turned. Right-clicking dismounts the spear.

tools.name: Rod of Discord
tools.effect: When used, it instantly teleports the player to the location of the cursor and inflicts the Chaos State debuff on the player for 6 seconds. Using the Rod of Discord while this debuff is active causes the player to lose health equal to 1/7 (14.29%) of their maximum health.

weapons.name: Empyrean Knives
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: When used, they throw a spread of 4 to 8 homing knives, each dealing damage and healing the player for 1.5% of the damage dealt. The knives bounce off of tiles twice and travel much farther than the Vampire Knives before spinning and fading away.

weapons.name: Holy Collider
weapons.source: Dropped by Providence
weapons.effect: Pressing ⚒ Use / Attack (default: Left Click) swings the sword back and forth, dealing 20% base damage and creating 6 short-lived flares on hit that deal 1% base damage. Holding ⚒ Use / Attack will instead charge up the sword for a powerful swing when the button is released, dealing full damage on hit.

items.name: Affliction
items.effect: While equipped, all the player's teammates in the same team are granted the Afflicted buff, which provides all the bonuses that the accessory itself provides.

items.name: The Absorber
items.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · 12% increased movement and jump speed · Attackers take immense damage and are afflicted with Absorber Affliction · Using a healing potion will spawn a green aura that lasts for 30 seconds · Walking into the aura removes all debuffs once and grants 2 HP/s regen, 8% damage, and 5% damage reduction · 5% of the damage from enemy attacks is converted into healing

items.name: The Community
items.effect: When equipped, it grants the player various offensive, defensive, and mobility stat boosts which scale as the player progresses through the game by defeating more bosses.

items.name: The Evolution
items.effect: Allows you to dodge projectiles, reflecting highly damaging mirror shards back at enemies · Attacks that deal less than 5% of your max life in damage will not be dodged · This dodge has a maximum cooldown of 90 seconds, shortened depending on the dodged attack's damage · Equipping multiple accessories that give this ability to dodge will reduce the cooldown by 15% each · Getting hit by the same enemy projectile type during cooldown will resist its damage by 25%

items.name: Ambrosial Ampoule
items.effect: +1 to +3 HP/s life regen based on missing health (Current: +[REGEN] HP/s) · Natural life regen is 50% more potent and returns 100% faster · You emit yellow light if visibility is enabled

items.name: Deific Amulet
items.effect: Releases a burst of homing star-bees, increases movement speed, and drenches you in Honey after taking damage · Increases the length of invincibility, with it increasing even more when at low health · Shift- ⚷ Open / Activate this item in your inventory to toggle Panic Necklace's effect

items.name: Arc Flash Ring
items.effect: While equipped, it grants the player's attacks a 5% chance to fire down an arc flash that deals 3x the weapon's base damage and inflicts the Electrified debuff for 3 seconds.

items.name: Badge of Bravery
items.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
items.effect: When equipped, it increases melee damage and critical strike chance by 10%, and armor penetration by 5.

items.name: Fire Gauntlet
items.why: Melee damage, speed and knockback, and sets enemies on fire. Upgrades from Mechanical Glove.

items.name: Reaper Tooth Necklace
items.effect: When equipped, it increases all damage by 20% and increases armor penetration by 30.

items.name: Warbanner of the Righteous
items.why: This requires being close to the boss to perform well.
items.effect: While equipped, it increases all damage depending on how close the player is to an enemy. The boost scales from -15% to +15%.

tools.name: Eye of Magnus
tools.effect: When used, it fires a blue-white energy mass that does not pierce nor pass through tiles, restores 20 mana and heals the player 10% of the damage dealt upon hitting an enemy, and inflicts the Marked for Death debuff. It sharply homes in on enemies within a 20-tile radius, gradually turning its trail pink as it moves closer to the target.

tools.name: Rod of Discord
tools.effect: When used, it instantly teleports the player to the location of the cursor and inflicts the Chaos State debuff on the player for 6 seconds. Using the Rod of Discord while this debuff is active causes the player to lose health equal to 1/7 (14.29%) of their maximum health.

weapons.name: Fetid Emesis
weapons.source: Dropped by The Old Duke
weapons.effect: It fires bullets at a gradually increasing rate, up to a maximum of 20 bullets per second after 5 seconds. After 7 seconds, the gun fires a massive spread of 11 rotten chunks outwards which deal 250% base damage and inflict the Sulphuric Poisoning debuff.

weapons.name: Halley's Inferno
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: It uses Gel for ammunition, with a 50% chance to not consume ammo. When used with its primary fire (⚒ Use / Attack), it fires a rapid burst of five blue comets that pierce four times.

weapons.name: Monsoon
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: When firing Wooden Arrows, four of the five arrows are converted into sharks, and the fifth, middle arrow is converted into a Typhoon Arrow. Typhoon Arrows erupt into a swirling typhoon on contact with enemies or tiles, dealing damage over time in a wide area.

weapons.name: Sulphuric Acid Cannon
weapons.source: Dropped by the Mauler during Tier 3 of the Acid Rain
weapons.effect: When used, it slowly fires acid rockets which home in on enemies and stick to them. After being stuck to an enemy for 3.33 seconds, the acid rocket creates a large sulphuric mist explosion, dealing 200% base damage and inflicting the Sulphuric Poisoning debuff.

weapons.name: Tau Cannon
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: It is one of the final upgrades to the Magna Cannon and Opal Striker, alongside the Ontological Despoiler. While holding, the player channels a glowing blue orb at the tip of the cannon which increases in charge level every second, as indicated by a pulse.

weapons.name: Starfleet
weapons.effect: Fires a barrage of star bullets.
weapons.why: Fires a barrage of star bullets
weapons.source: Crafted at an Ancient Manipulator

weapons.name: Pearl God
weapons.effect: Alternates a lifesteal bullet and three pearlescent bullets.
weapons.why: Alternates a lifesteal bullet and three pearlescent bullets
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil

weapons.name: Daemon's Flame
weapons.effect: Fires arrows that spawn homing flames.
weapons.why: Fires arrows that spawn homing flames
weapons.source: Dropped by Polterghast

tools.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
tools.effect: It fires a small claret round that explodes into 20 small floating blood orbs upon hitting an enemy. When collected by the player, each orb reduces the duration of the Potion Sickness debuff by 0.33 seconds.

tools.effect: When used, it fires a massive planetary stratus orb that can pass through tiles.

weapons.name: Dark Spark
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: When used, it initially fires a single black beam of light that splits into six different beams as it charges. Over 6 seconds, these beams will change to white and, after another 4 seconds, various colors.

weapons.name: Phantasmal Fury
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: When used, it fires a swirling vortex of souls around the player. While swirling around the player, souls deal 30% base damage but have twice as much knockback.

weapons.name: Shadowbolt Staff
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: When used, it fires a shadowbolt that can pass through tiles. After traveling far enough or hitting an enemy, the shadowbolt creates a platform that it rebounds off of after a delay.

weapons.name: Venusian Trident
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: When used, it fires an infernal trident that causes a very large explosion upon hitting a tile or an enemy, releasing four to nine flaming shards that fall to the floor and deal 2% of the weapon's damage. The tridents, explosions, and flaming shards inflict the Daybroken debuff, and always critically strike.

weapons.name: Vitriolic Viper
weapons.source: Dropped by The Old Duke
weapons.effect: When used, it charges up to fire a spread of radioactive beams that inflict the Irradiated debuff, whose spread gets tighter the longer it is charged. After 1 second to fully charge, it instead fires a large spread of 33 short-range fangs that inflict the Sulphuric Poisoning debuff.

weapons.name: Eidolon Staff
weapons.source: Dropped by Eidolon Wyrms (after Polterghast)
weapons.effect: Fires a spread of ancient light and a spinning ice cluster that inflicts Frozen.
weapons.why: Ancient light and freezing ice.

weapons.name: Eidolic Wail
weapons.source: Dropped by Eidolon Wyrms (after Polterghast), or by the Primordial Wyrm
weapons.effect: Fires a string of bouncing sound waves that slow down on enemy hits.
weapons.why: Bouncing sound waves.

weapons.name: Fate's Reveal
weapons.source: Dropped by Polterghast
weapons.effect: Spawns ghostly fireballs that follow the player.
weapons.why: Following ghostly fireballs.

weapons.name: Ghastly Visage
weapons.source: Dropped by Polterghast, or craftable at a Shimmer Transmutation
weapons.effect: Fires homing ghast energy that explodes.
weapons.why: Exploding homing ghast energy.

weapons.name: Alpha Draconis
weapons.source: Crafted at a Mythril or Orichalcum Anvil
weapons.effect: Calls a meteor shower at the cursor; hits drop Starbursts you can spend to summon Draco.
weapons.why: Meteor shower with a summonable Draco.

tools.name: Eye of Magnus
tools.effect: When used, it fires a blue-white energy mass that does not pierce nor pass through tiles, restores 20 mana and heals the player 10% of the damage dealt upon hitting an enemy, and inflicts the Marked for Death debuff. It sharply homes in on enemies within a 20-tile radius, gradually turning its trail pink as it moves closer to the target.

tools.name: Rod of Discord
tools.effect: When used, it instantly teleports the player to the location of the cursor and inflicts the Chaos State debuff on the player for 6 seconds. Using the Rod of Discord while this debuff is active causes the player to lose health equal to 1/7 (14.29%) of their maximum health.

weapons.name: Ace's High
weapons.source: Crafted at a Cosmic Anvil
weapons.effect: When used, it fires a line of four playing cards in the order of a heart, club, diamond, and spade, with a mild delay between each set. Each of the cards has varying effects.

weapons.name: Chicken Cannon
weapons.source: Dropped by Yharon, Dragon of Rebirth
weapons.effect: When used, it rapidly fires chicken rockets that bounce straight up when hitting the ground before causing a gigantic explosion after a short delay, inflicting the Dragonfire debuff. The explosion lingers for a few seconds and ignores immunity frames.

weapons.name: Dragon's Breath
weapons.source: Dropped by Yharon, Dragon of Rebirth
weapons.effect: It uses Gel for ammunition, with an 80% chance to not consume ammo. When used, it fires a stream of fireballs that pierce infinitely but lose 5% damage per hit.

weapons.name: Starmada
weapons.source: Crafted at a Cosmic Anvil
weapons.effect: These attacks can be used independently. Timing these attacks together increases damage and reduces the spread of star shots, while boosting the number of star shots fired.

weapons.name: Tyranny's End
weapons.source: Crafted at a Cosmic Anvil
weapons.effect: When used with its primary fire (⚒ Use / Attack), it converts Musket Balls into high-velocity bullets, which inflict the Marked for Death debuff on hit and ignore enemy defense if it is less than 1,000. If the main shot critically strikes, six bullets will appear from the sides of the target and will be fired towards it, each dealing 17.5% of the weapon's damage.

weapons.name: Kingsbane
weapons.effect: A rapid gun firing king-slaying rounds.
weapons.why: A rapid gun firing king-slaying rounds
weapons.source: Crafted at a Cosmic Anvil

weapons.name: Drataliornus
weapons.effect: Fires solar dragon arrows.
weapons.why: Fires solar dragon arrows

armor.name: Auric Tesla armor
armor.source: Crafted at Cosmic Anvil
armor.effect: Inherits the Tarragon, Bloodflare, and God Slayer set bonuses. Auric Tesla adds: immunity to Auric Ore damage and knockback · Magic Carpet flight after jumps and wing time run out (hold Shift and right-click the leggings to disable) · Heartreach effect (larger heart pickup range) · enemies may drop extra hearts on death · enemies below 50% health drop a heart when hit (5-second cooldown).
armor.desc: The Auric Tesla armor is a post- Moon Lord armor set. If the full set is equipped, the player will emit afterimages and release a trail of golden sparkles while moving.
armor.headpieceBonus: +50% ranged damage · +40% ranged critical strike chance · +30% ammo cost reduction · +10% movement speed

weapons.source: Crafted at a Bookcase
weapons.effect: When used, it fires 5 dust blows that pass through tiles and converge at the cursor into an explosion of dust that inflicts the Armor Crunch debuff. weapons.name: Void Vortex
weapons.source: Crafted at a Cosmic Anvil
weapons.effect: When used, it summons a circular spread of 12 tile-ignoring electric orbs along with a larger orb in the center of the ring at the cursor's position that deals 400% of the weapon's damage. weapons.name: Yharim's Crystal
weapons.source: Dropped by Yharon
weapons.effect: When used, it fires six red and orange beams that converge into one yellow beam as it charges, dealing massive damage and inflicting the Dragonfire debuff on contact. Yharim's Crystal cannot deal any knockback.

weapons.name: Sanctified Spark
weapons.source: Dropped by Impious Immolators
weapons.effect: When used, it summons an Impious Immolator sentry that slowly follows the player and rapidly fires flame bursts at the nearest enemy which inflicts the Holy Flames debuff. It will briefly pause between attacks, during which it will fire one healing orb that heals 5 health each for every 4 minion slots the player has.

weapons.name: Dimension-Tearing Disk
weapons.source: Dropped by The Devourer of Gods
weapons.effect: When used, it throws a disk that passes through tiles and returns to the player after traveling a moderate distance. When thrown at nearby enemies, it will fire a nebula laser beam that deal 70% of the weapon's damage.

weapons.name: Dynamic Pursuer
weapons.source: Crafted at a Cosmic Anvil
weapons.effect: When used, it throws a high-velocity boomerang which returns on hit or after 0.75 seconds. It initially moves slowly upon returning, but gradually accelerate until it reaches the player.

weapons.name: Seraphim
weapons.source: Crafted at a Cosmic Anvil
weapons.effect: When used, it throws a holy dagger that naturally slows down exponentially as it travels, while also reducing its speed by 60% for each enemy hit. After 0.83 seconds, it glows and bursts into 6 daggers and an angelic light orb.

weapons.name: Wrathwing
weapons.source: Dropped by Yharon
weapons.effect: When used, it throws a fiery javelin which homes in on enemies while releasing gravity-affected fireballs as it travels, which explode violently on contact. The javelin also inflicts the Dragonfire debuff.

weapons.name: The Old Reaper
weapons.source: Dropped by The Old Duke
weapons.effect: When fired, it throws a scythe which spawns unstable isotope projectiles on enemy hits that explode after a brief delay.

items.name: Seraph Tracers
items.effect: Allows flight and slow fall · Flight time: 4.17 seconds · Max horizontal speed: Excellent · Max vertical speed: Excellent · Horizontal acceleration: Excellent · Vertical acceleration: Great · 50% increased running acceleration · Provides the effects of Angel Treads · Provides immunity to lava and damaging tiles, including Auric Ore · Shift-Right Click this item in your inventory to toggle the wings · 'Taking speed EVEN FURTHER BEYOND!'

items.name: Wings of Rebirth
items.source: Dropped by Yharon, Dragon of Rebirth
items.effect: When equipped, they allow the player to fly and glide.

items.name: Ascendant Insignia
items.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
items.effect: Increases wing flight time by 50%, movement and jump speed by 15%, and acceleration by 1.5x · Pressing Ascendant Insignia Hotkey grants you the power of ascension, providing infinite flight time for 4 seconds · Ascension has a 40 second cooldown

items.name: Asgardian Aegis
items.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · Allows the ability to ram dash, empowered by a cosmic inferno · This dash can ram through enemies without taking damage

items.name: Statis' Void Sash
items.effect: Provides a high-speed dash · 20% increased movement speed, 32% increased jump speed, and negates fall damage · Increases movement acceleration and deceleration by 1.85x · Allows the user to swim, climb walls, and auto jump · Grants or improves the ability to dodge attacks · Shift- ⚷ Open / Activate this item in your inventory to toggle the Climbing Claws

items.name: Affliction
items.source: Dropped by Polterghast in Expert Mode
items.effect: While equipped, all the player's teammates in the same team are granted the Afflicted buff, which provides all the bonuses that the accessory itself provides.

items.name: Dark Sun Ring
items.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · 12% increased damage · +0.5 HP/s life regen and +2 max minions · Increased minion knockback · Grants various buffs as the day goes on · 'Contains the power of the dark sun'

items.name: The Absorber
items.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · 12% increased movement and jump speed · Attackers take immense damage and are afflicted with Absorber Affliction · Using a healing potion will spawn a green aura that lasts for 30 seconds · Walking into the aura removes all debuffs once and grants 2 HP/s regen, 8% damage, and 5% damage reduction · 5% of the damage from enemy attacks is converted into healing

items.name: The Amalgam
items.effect: All attacks inflict a variety of debuffs, 200% increased elemental debuff damage · Most buffs last twice as long, and persist after dying · Taking damage confuses nearby enemies and spawns a dank creeper · The dank creeper flies above you, exploding into several shaderain clouds · Grants or improves the ability to dodge attacks · After dodging, summon damage and crit chance are boosted by 10% · 'You have no idea how it's staying together' · Expert

items.name: The Community
items.effect: When equipped, it grants the player various offensive, defensive, and mobility stat boosts which scale as the player progresses through the game by defeating more bosses.

items.name: The Evolution
items.effect: Allows you to dodge projectiles, reflecting highly damaging mirror shards back at enemies · Attacks that deal less than 5% of your max life in damage will not be dodged · This dodge has a maximum cooldown of 90 seconds, shortened depending on the dodged attack's damage · Equipping multiple accessories that give this ability to dodge will reduce the cooldown by 15% each · Getting hit by the same enemy projectile type during cooldown will resist its damage by 25%

items.name: Chalice of the Blood God
items.effect: Increases max HP by 25% · +2 HP/s life regen and reduces the cooldown of healing potions by 25% · Taking more than 5 damage converts the hit into a damage over time bleed effect · This bleeding does not interfere with life regeneration · Drinking a healing potion removes some of the remaining bleed, up to 50% of its heal value · Unequipping this accessory while bleeding inflicts the remaining damage instantly · Grants immunity to Bleeding , Burning Blood , Heavy Bleeding and Laceration · 'All that for a drop of blood...'

items.name: Radiance
items.effect: +1 to +4 HP/s life regen based on missing health (Current: +[REGEN] HP/s) · Reduces damage over time taken by 10 HP/s and jump-starts regeneration after a damaging debuff ends · Natural life regen is 50% more potent and returns 100% faster · You emit shining blue light if visibility is enabled · 'A once putrid crystal, now glimmering with immaculate purity'

items.name: Rampart of Deities
items.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · Releases a blast of homing star-bees, increases movement speed, and drenches you in Honey after taking damage · Increases the length of invincibility, with it increasing even more when at low health or taking high damage attacks · Reduces damage taken by 25% when below 50% life · Absorbs 25% of damage done to players on your team when you are above 25% life · Shift- ⚷ Open / Activate this item in your inventory to toggle Panic Necklace's effect

items.name: The Sponge
items.effect: After eight seconds of equipping the item without taking damage, a barrier covers its user, which grants 10% damage reduction. As the barrier is formed, it builds up to 120 shield durability at a rate of 12 durability per second.

items.name: Arc Flash Ring
items.effect: While equipped, it grants the player's attacks a 5% chance to fire down an arc flash that deals 3x the weapon's base damage and inflicts the Electrified debuff for 3 seconds.

items.name: Eclipse Mirror
items.effect: +10 maximum stealth · 6% increased rogue damage and rogue crit chance · Enemies are less likely to target you, even in the abyss · Stealth generates 25% faster when standing still and is boosted while moving if not attacking · Stealth strikes only expend 50% of your max stealth · Grants or improves the ability to dodge attacks · Dodging an attack restores stealth and releases a burst of highly damaging darksun light · 'Its reflection shows naught but darkness'

items.name: Nanotech
items.effect: Rogue projectiles create nanoblades as they travel · Stealth strikes summon nanobeams and sparks on enemy hits · Stealth strikes have lifesteal, +15 armor penetration, deal 5% more damage · 15% increased rogue damage and 15% increased rogue velocity · Stealth strikes grant lifesteal and 10% critical strike chance to non-stealth strikes for 10 seconds

items.name: Reaper Tooth Necklace
items.effect: When equipped, it increases all damage by 20% and increases armor penetration by 30.

items.name: Glove of Precision
items.source: Purchased from the Bandit for 48 gold after Plantera has been defeated
items.effect: Decreases rogue attack speed by 15% · Increases rogue damage and critical strike chance by 10%, and velocity by 15%

items.name: Spectral Veil
items.why: This is difficult and risky to use.
items.effect: While equipped, it makes stealth generate 15% faster.

tools.name: Eye of Magnus
tools.effect: When used, it fires a blue-white energy mass that does not pierce nor pass through tiles, restores 20 mana and heals the player 10% of the damage dealt upon hitting an enemy, and inflicts the Marked for Death debuff. It sharply homes in on enemies within a 20-tile radius, gradually turning its trail pink as it moves closer to the target.

tools.name: Rod of Discord
tools.effect: When used, it instantly teleports the player to the location of the cursor and inflicts the Chaos State debuff on the player for 6 seconds. Using the Rod of Discord while this debuff is active causes the player to lose health equal to 1/7 (14.29%) of their maximum health.

weapons.name: Draconic Destruction
weapons.source: Crafted at a Draedon's Forge
weapons.effect: When swung, it fires a high-velocity sword beam that pierces infinitely, passes through tiles, and splits into 8 more sword beams in a circular formation on enemy hits. The split beams move out for a quick moment before erratically flying up and down constantly while spacing away from each other as they travel before dissipating.

weapons.name: Earth
weapons.source: Crafted at a Draedon's Forge
weapons.effect: When used, the sword is rapidly swung in a circular motion around the player, leaving behind a rainbow trail, before swinging towards the cursor with a larger slash. The larger slash spawns 3 rainbow gaia meteors from the sky that deal 120% base damage and explode on hit, dealing an additional 75% base damage.

weapons.name: Illustrious Knives
weapons.source: Crafted at a Draedon's Forge
weapons.effect: When used, the weapon launches a spread of 4-8 slow moving green knives, similar to the Vampire Knives. The knives are destroyed upon contact with tiles but will rapidly accelerate and home in on nearby enemies.

weapons.name: Ozzathoth
weapons.source: Crafted at a Draedon's Forge
weapons.effect: While deployed, it constantly fires roughly-stationary cosmic orbs. The cosmic orbs do not pass through tiles, and they deal 40% of the weapon's damage and have an innate 100 armor penetration.

weapons.name: Red Sun
weapons.source: Crafted at a Draedon's Forge
weapons.effect: When it is swung, a large number of solar flares fall from the sky at varying speeds and angles. The flares explode after some time or upon hitting an enemy, releasing multiple homing fragments when they do.

weapons.name: Triactis' True Paladinian Mage-Hammer of Might
weapons.source: Crafted at a Draedon's Forge
weapons.effect: When used, it throws a heavy, gravity-affected hammer that will return to the player after striking an enemy. Every hit of the hammer spawns a prismatic light flare which orbits around the struck enemy.

items.name: Shattered Community
items.effect: It is the exhumed form of The Community. It grants the following effects while equipped:

items.name: The Absorber
items.effect: Grants immunity to knockback · 12% increased movement and jump speed · Attackers take immense damage and are afflicted with Absorber Affliction · Using a healing potion will spawn a green aura that lasts for 30 seconds · Walking into the aura removes all debuffs once and grants 2 HP/s regen, 8% damage, and 5% damage reduction · 5% of the damage from enemy attacks is converted into healing

items.name: The Amalgam
items.effect: All attacks inflict a variety of debuffs, 200% increased elemental debuff damage · Most buffs last twice as long, and persist after dying · Taking damage confuses nearby enemies and spawns a dank creeper · The dank creeper flies above you, exploding into several shaderain clouds · Grants or improves the ability to dodge attacks · After dodging, summon damage and crit chance are boosted by 10% · 'You have no idea how it's staying together' · Expert

items.name: The Evolution
items.effect: Allows you to dodge projectiles, reflecting highly damaging mirror shards back at enemies · Attacks that deal less than 5% of your max life in damage will not be dodged · This dodge has a maximum cooldown of 90 seconds, shortened depending on the dodged attack's damage · Equipping multiple accessories that give this ability to dodge will reduce the cooldown by 15% each · Getting hit by the same enemy projectile type during cooldown will resist its damage by 25%

items.name: Chalice of the Blood God
items.effect: Increases max HP by 25% · +2 HP/s life regen and reduces the cooldown of healing potions by 25% · Taking more than 5 damage converts the hit into a damage over time bleed effect · This bleeding does not interfere with life regeneration · Drinking a healing potion removes some of the remaining bleed, up to 50% of its heal value · Unequipping this accessory while bleeding inflicts the remaining damage instantly · Grants immunity to Bleeding , Burning Blood , Heavy Bleeding and Laceration · 'All that for a drop of blood...'

items.name: Arc Flash Ring
items.effect: While equipped, it grants the player's attacks a 5% chance to fire down an arc flash that deals 3x the weapon's base damage and inflicts the Electrified debuff for 3 seconds.

items.name: Calamity
items.effect: When equipped, a flaming aura spawns at the player's cursor. While an enemy is within range, the aura glows and continuously deals 320 damage at a rate of 12 hits per second, inflicting the Vulnerability Hex debuff.

items.name: Daawnlight Spirit Origin
items.source: Crafted at a Mythril Anvil or Orichalcum Anvil
items.effect: All ranged weapons can supercrit when critical strike chance is over 100% · Marks enemies and bosses with bullseyes which boost critical strike chance when hit · Extra critical strike chance quickly fades over time · Summons a heroic spirit from another world if visibility is on or in vanity slots · 'A strand of a lost cosmos remains, waiting for its master'

items.effect: Increases view range for guns (Right click to zoom out) · 10% increased ranged damage and critical strike chance

tools.name: Eye of Magnus
tools.effect: When used, it fires a blue-white energy mass that does not pierce nor pass through tiles, restores 20 mana and heals the player 10% of the damage dealt upon hitting an enemy, and inflicts the Marked for Death debuff. It sharply homes in on enemies within a 20-tile radius, gradually turning its trail pink as it moves closer to the target.

tools.name: Rod of Harmony
tools.effect: It is the direct upgrade to the Rod of Discord, instantly teleporting the player to the location of the cursor when used, but without inflicting the Chaos State debuff.

weapons.name: Apotheosis
weapons.source: Crafted at a Draedon's Forge
weapons.effect: When used, it summons a cosmic portal that releases a mini Devourer of Gods that swarms enemies and fires lasers at them, before disappearing 5 seconds later. The mini-Devourer of Gods inflicts God Slayer Inferno and Whispering Death.

weapons.name: Eternity
weapons.source: Crafted at a Draedon's Forge
weapons.effect: When used, it will create a large circle, which inside will have five crystals, a beam, and a group of projectiles that create a flower shape while traveling, all of which will be centered around a nearby enemy. The beam will travel in an infinity shape.

weapons.name: Rainbow Party Cannon
weapons.source: Crafted at a Draedon's Forge
weapons.effect: When used, a cannon appears locked to the player's location, pointing either left or right towards the direction of the cursor. It is unable to change direction until released.

weapons.name: Staff of Blushie
weapons.source: Crafted at a Draedon's Forge
weapons.effect: Upon holding the ⚒ Use / Attack button with the weapon in hand, five blue gears will appear on the screen which are connected by a series of chains, and a row of blue fire appears some distance below.

weapons.name: Sylvestaff
weapons.source: Crafted at a Draedon's Forge
weapons.effect: When used, it fires a beam with a pink, white, and blue trail that bounces off tiles in quick succession and pierces infinitely. When enemies are nearby, the beam will emit small splitting beams that are aimed towards the nearest enemy and do not bounce on tiles.

weapons.name: The Dance of Light
weapons.source: Crafted at a Draedon's Forge
weapons.effect: When used, it rapidly summons four pairs of fast inaccurate light blades from a cone around the player towards the cursor's direction. Each pair of light blades will curve, converge, and home with each other and they pierce once and go through tiles.

armor.name: Demonshade Armor
armor.source: Crafted at Draedon's Forge
armor.headpieceBonus: +45% damage · +100% summon damage · +30% critical strike chance · +25% melee speed · +30% chance to not consume ammo · +30% movement speed · 1.5x acceleration · +200 maximum mana · +10 minion slots · +2 HP/s and +400% natural life regen while standing still (30-second headstart) · When damaged, shadowbeams (300/600/900) and demon scythes (500/1000/1500) rain from the sky
armor.effect: Press the armor set bonus key to inflict Enraged on nearby enemies and yourself for 10 seconds: enemies take 1.5x damage but deal 1.25x damage to you.

armor.name: Gem Tech armor
armor.source: Crafted at Draedon's Forge
armor.effect: Power Gems - Six gem fragments idly orbit you; one for each class, and a base gem · Each active gem provides a bonus for its respective class, while the defensive gem grants defensive boosts · Powerful enemy hits will dislodge gems, launching them into the nearest enemy for huge damage · Lost gems regenerate after a while · The lost gem is the same class as the weapon you are using, so expect to switch weapons often. · The type of gem lost is the same as the class of the most recently used weapon · If said gem has already been lost, the base gem is lost instead · When a gem is lost, it breaks off and homes towards the nearest enemy or boss, dealing a base of 40000 damage · Gems have a 30 second delay before they appear again · The red gem grants 130 maximum stealth, increased rogue stats, and makes stealth only consumable by rogue weapons · The yellow gem provides increased melee stats and makes melee attacks release shards on hit with a cooldown. This cooldown is shorter for true melee attacks · The green gem provides increased ranged stats and causes flechettes to fly swiftly towards targets when they are damaged by a ranged projectile · The blue gem grants 4 maximum minions, increased summon damage, and negates the summon damage penalty while wielding non-summoner weapons · The violet gem grants 100 maximum mana, increased magic stats, and makes mana rapidly regenerate when holding a non-magic weapon · The pink base gem grants 75 defense, increased damage reduction, movement speed, jump speed, and +1 HP/s life regen · When all gems exist simultaneously, hitting a target with any weapon grants you +1 HP/s life regen for 8 seconds · This is increased to +1.5 HP/s life regen if a weapon of another class is used during that 8 second period for 2.5 seconds
armor.desc: Gem Tech armor is a post- Moon Lord armor set.

items.name: Arc Flash Ring

items.name: Calamity

items.name: Ethereal Talisman
